title: Fourier-RWKV: A Multi-State Perception Network for Efficient Image Dehazing
summary: Image dehazing is crucial for reliable visual perception, yet it remains highly challenging under real-world non-uniform haze conditions. Although Transformer-based methods excel at capturing global context, their quadratic computational complexity hinders real-time deployment. To address this, we propose Fourier Receptance Weighted Key Value (Fourier-RWKV), a novel dehazing framework based on a Multi-State Perception paradigm. The model achieves comprehensive haze degradation modeling with linear complexity by synergistically integrating three distinct perceptual states: (1) Spatial-form Perception, realized through the Deformable Quad-directional Token Shift (DQ-Shift) operation, which dynamically adjusts receptive fields to accommodate local haze variations; (2) Frequency-domain Perception, implemented within the Fourier Mix block, which extends the core WKV attention mechanism of RWKV from the spatial domain to the Fourier domain, preserving the long-range dependencies essential for global haze estimation while mitigating spatial attenuation; (3) Semantic-relation Perception, facilitated by the Semantic Bridge Module (SBM), which utilizes Dynamic Semantic Kernel Fusion (DSK-Fusion) to precisely align encoder-decoder features and suppress artifacts. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Fourier-RWKV delivers state-of-the-art performance across diverse haze scenarios while significantly reducing computational overhead, establishing a favorable trade-off between restoration quality and practical efficiency. Code is available at: https://github.com/Dilizlr/Fourier-RWKV.

title: Accuracy Does Not Guarantee Human-Likeness in Monocular Depth Estimators
summary: Monocular depth estimation is a fundamental capability for real-world applications such as autonomous driving and robotics. Although deep neural networks (DNNs) have achieved superhuman accuracy on physical-based benchmarks, a key challenge remains: aligning model representations with human perception, a promising strategy for enhancing model robustness and interpretability. Research in object recognition has revealed a complex trade-off between model accuracy and human-like behavior, raising a question whether a similar divergence exist in depth estimation, particularly for natural outdoor scenes where benchmarks rely on sensor-based ground truth rather than human perceptual estimates. In this study, we systematically investigated the relationship between model accuracy and human similarity across 69 monocular depth estimators using the KITTI dataset. To dissect the structure of error patterns on a factor-by-factor basis, we applied affine fitting to decompose prediction errors into interpretable components. Intriguingly, our results reveal while humans and DNNs share certain estimation biases (positive error correlations), we observed distinct trade-off relationships between model accuracy and human similarity. This finding indicates that improving accuracy does not necessarily lead to more human-like behavior, underscoring the necessity of developing multifaceted, human-centric evaluations beyond traditional accuracy.

title: Information-Dense Reasoning for Efficient and Auditable Security Alert Triage
summary: Security Operations Centers face massive, heterogeneous alert streams under minute-level service windows, creating the Alert Triage Latency Paradox: verbose reasoning chains ensure accuracy and compliance but incur prohibitive latency and token costs, while minimal chains sacrifice transparency and auditability. Existing solutions fail: signature systems are brittle, anomaly methods lack actionability, and fully cloud-hosted LLMs raise latency, cost, and privacy concerns. We propose AIDR, a hybrid cloud-edge framework that addresses this trade-off through constrained information-density optimization. The core innovation is gradient-based compression of reasoning chains to retain only decision-critical steps--minimal evidence sufficient to justify predictions while respecting token and latency budgets. We demonstrate that this approach preserves decision-relevant information while minimizing complexity. We construct compact datasets by distilling alerts into 3-5 high-information bullets (68% token reduction), train domain-specialized experts via LoRA, and deploy a cloud-edge architecture: a cloud LLM routes alerts to on-premises experts generating SOAR-ready JSON. Experiments demonstrate AIDR achieves higher accuracy and 40.6% latency reduction versus Chain-of-Thought, with robustness to data corruption and out-of-distribution generalization, enabling auditable and efficient SOC triage with full data residency compliance.

title: RAVES-Calib: Robust, Accurate and Versatile Extrinsic Self Calibration Using Optimal Geometric Features
summary: In this paper, we present a user-friendly LiDAR-camera calibration toolkit that is compatible with various LiDAR and camera sensors and requires only a single pair of laser points and a camera image in targetless environments. Our approach eliminates the need for an initial transform and remains robust even with large positional and rotational LiDAR-camera extrinsic parameters. We employ the Gluestick pipeline to establish 2D-3D point and line feature correspondences for a robust and automatic initial guess. To enhance accuracy, we quantitatively analyze the impact of feature distribution on calibration results and adaptively weight the cost of each feature based on these metrics. As a result, extrinsic parameters are optimized by filtering out the adverse effects of inferior features. We validated our method through extensive experiments across various LiDAR-camera sensors in both indoor and outdoor settings. The results demonstrate that our method provides superior robustness and accuracy compared to SOTA techniques. Our code is open-sourced on GitHub to benefit the community.

title: Security Analysis of Integer Learning with Errors with Rejection Sampling
summary: At ASIACRYPT 2018, a digital attack based on linear least squares was introduced for a variant of the learning with errors (LWE) problem which omits modular reduction known as the integer learning with errors problem (ILWE). In this paper, we present a theoretical and experimental study of the effectiveness of the attack when applied directly to small parameter ILWE instances found in popular digital signature schemes such as CRYSTALS-Dilithium which utilize rejection sampling. Unlike other studies which form ILWE instances based on additional information obtained from side-channel attacks, we take a more direct approach to the problem by constructing our ILWE instance from only the obtained signatures. We outline and introduce novel techniques in our simulation designs such as modular polynomial arithmetic via matrices in $\mathbb{R}$, as well as algorithms for handling large sample sizes efficiently. Our experimental results reinforce the proclaimed security of signature schemes based on ILWE. We additionally discuss the implications of our work and digital signatures as a whole in regards to real-world applications such as in Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS).

title: The Instability of Painlevé Equations in Recovering Largest Eigenvalue Distributions of GUE, LUE, JUE and an Attempt of Solution to It
summary:
The distribution of the largest eigenvalue for the three classical unitary ensembles -- GUE, LUE, and JUE -- admits two complementary exact descriptions: (i) as Fredholm determinants of their orthogonal polynomial correlation kernels and (ii) as isomonodromic $τ$--functions governed by Painlevé equations. For finite $n$, the associated Jimbo-Miwa-Okamoto $σ$-forms are $\PIV$ (GUE), $\mathrm{PV}$ (LUE), and $\PVI$ (JUE); under soft- or hard-edge scalings these degenerate to $\PII$ or $\PIIIp$ descriptions of the Tracy-Widom and hard-edge laws \cite{tracy1994level,forrester2003painleve,deift1999orthogonal}.
  It is well known among random matrix theorists (for example Folkmar Bornemann) that the Fredholm determinant is a more numerically stable and accurate way to compute the CDF of the largest eigenvalue for GUE, LUE, JUE than direct Painlevé integration. The aim of this paper is not to improve on Fredholm methods, but to see to what extent one can numerically recover the \emph{correct} Painlevé solution from finite-$n$ data and how unstable this reconstruction is. Numerically, we verify the equality between the Fredholm- and Painlevé-based CDFs by combining (a) high-accuracy Nyström discretizations of the finite-$n$ Fredholm determinants \cite{bornemann2010numerical} with (b) an anchored, branch-locked integration of the $σ$-form ODEs, where anchors are extracted from local least-squares fits to $\log\det(I-\mathsf K)$. Our results confirm agreement across GUE/LUE/JUE with precision of $O(10^{-3})$ to $O(10^{-5})$ (occasionally $O(10^{-2})$) and illustrate the finite-$n$ to scaling-limit transition. The theoretical connections to $τ$-functions and Virasoro constraints follow the framework of \cite{adler2000random,forrester2003painleve}

title: GeoLoom: High-quality Geometric Diagram Generation from Textual Input
summary: High-quality geometric diagram generation presents both a challenge and an opportunity: it demands strict spatial accuracy while offering well-defined constraints to guide generation. Inspired by recent advances in geometry problem solving that employ formal languages and symbolic solvers for enhanced correctness and interpretability, we propose GeoLoom, a novel framework for text-to-diagram generation in geometric domains. GeoLoom comprises two core components: an autoformalization module that translates natural language into a specifically designed generation-oriented formal language GeoLingua, and a coordinate solver that maps formal constraints to precise coordinates using the efficient Monte Carlo optimization. To support this framework, we introduce GeoNF, a dataset aligning natural language geometric descriptions with formal GeoLingua descriptions. We further propose a constraint-based evaluation metric that quantifies structural deviation, offering mathematically grounded supervision for iterative refinement. Empirical results demonstrate that GeoLoom significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in structural fidelity, providing a principled foundation for interpretable and scalable diagram generation.

title: Framing Climate Change on YouTube: North-South Divides in Narratives and Public Engagement
summary: Climate change debates have gained increasing visibility on social media, with YouTube emerging as one of the most influential platforms for political communication. Reaching billions of users worldwide, it functions both as a news outlet and as a space for public discourse. While existing studies of climate discourse on YouTube often adopt a global perspective, this study examines the platform through the lens of the Global North-South divide. We analyse a dataset of 758 climate-related videos and their comment sections, applying topic modelling and sentiment analysis to identify recurring discursive patterns. Through these patterns, we recognise parallels with respect to debates in international climate negotiations. The findings reveal notable differences. Videos from the Global North and Global South reflect real-world divides, with the North emphasising the need for policies to curb carbon emissions, while the South highlights developmental priorities. A key area of convergence between the regions lies in the shared recognition of the importance of emissions reduction and international agreements. Audience responses, however, diverge more sharply: comment sections under Global North videos are dominated by criticism, conspiracy, and climate fatigue, whereas those under Global South videos are generally more supportive, constructive, and knowledge-oriented. Overall, the study demonstrates how YouTube reflects and reshapes global climate politics, while also revealing the gap between curated narratives and public sentiment. Bridging these divides may contribute to more inclusive and cooperative approaches to climate action.

title: A Practical Framework for Evaluating Medical AI Security: Reproducible Assessment of Jailbreaking and Privacy Vulnerabilities Across Clinical Specialties
summary: Medical Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for clinical decision support across diverse specialties, yet systematic evaluation of their robustness to adversarial misuse and privacy leakage remains inaccessible to most researchers. Existing security benchmarks require GPU clusters, commercial API access, or protected health data -- barriers that limit community participation in this critical research area. We propose a practical, fully reproducible framework for evaluating medical AI security under realistic resource constraints. Our framework design covers multiple medical specialties stratified by clinical risk -- from high-risk domains such as emergency medicine and psychiatry to general practice -- addressing jailbreaking attacks (role-playing, authority impersonation, multi-turn manipulation) and privacy extraction attacks. All evaluation utilizes synthetic patient records requiring no IRB approval. The framework is designed to run entirely on consumer CPU hardware using freely available models, eliminating cost barriers. We present the framework specification including threat models, data generation methodology, evaluation protocols, and scoring rubrics. This proposal establishes a foundation for comparative security assessment of medical-specialist models and defense mechanisms, advancing the broader goal of ensuring safe and trustworthy medical AI systems.

title: Ground Slow, Move Fast: A Dual-System Foundation Model for Generalizable Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: While recent large vision-language models (VLMs) have improved generalization in vision-language navigation (VLN), existing methods typically rely on end-to-end pipelines that map vision-language inputs directly to short-horizon discrete actions. Such designs often produce fragmented motions, incur high latency, and struggle with real-world challenges like dynamic obstacle avoidance. We propose DualVLN, the first dual-system VLN foundation model that synergistically integrates high-level reasoning with low-level action execution. System 2, a VLM-based global planner, "grounds slowly" by predicting mid-term waypoint goals via image-grounded reasoning. System 1, a lightweight, multi-modal conditioning Diffusion Transformer policy, "moves fast" by leveraging both explicit pixel goals and latent features from System 2 to generate smooth and accurate trajectories. The dual-system design enables robust real-time control and adaptive local decision-making in complex, dynamic environments. By decoupling training, the VLM retains its generalization, while System 1 achieves interpretable and effective local navigation. DualVLN outperforms prior methods across all VLN benchmarks and real-world experiments demonstrate robust long-horizon planning and real-time adaptability in dynamic environments.

title: Embodied Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Manipulation Planning with Embodied World Model
summary: World models have emerged as a pivotal component in robot manipulation planning, enabling agents to predict future environmental states and reason about the consequences of actions before execution. While video-generation models are increasingly adopted, they often lack rigorous physical grounding, leading to hallucinations and a failure to maintain consistency in long-horizon physical constraints. To address these limitations, we propose Embodied Tree of Thoughts (EToT), a novel Real2Sim2Real planning framework that leverages a physics-based interactive digital twin as an embodied world model. EToT formulates manipulation planning as a tree search expanded through two synergistic mechanisms: (1) Priori Branching, which generates diverse candidate execution paths based on semantic and spatial analysis; and (2) Reflective Branching, which utilizes VLMs to diagnose execution failures within the simulator and iteratively refine the planning tree with corrective actions. By grounding high-level reasoning in a physics simulator, our framework ensures that generated plans adhere to rigid-body dynamics and collision constraints. We validate EToT on a suite of short- and long-horizon manipulation tasks, where it consistently outperforms baselines by effectively predicting physical dynamics and adapting to potential failures. Website at https://embodied-tree-of-thoughts.github.io .

title: ClinicalTrialsHub: Bridging Registries and Literature for Comprehensive Clinical Trial Access
summary: We present ClinicalTrialsHub, an interactive search-focused platform that consolidates all data from ClinicalTrials.gov and augments it by automatically extracting and structuring trial-relevant information from PubMed research articles. Our system effectively increases access to structured clinical trial data by 83.8% compared to relying on ClinicalTrials.gov alone, with potential to make access easier for patients, clinicians, researchers, and policymakers, advancing evidence-based medicine. ClinicalTrialsHub uses large language models such as GPT-5.1 and Gemini-3-Pro to enhance accessibility. The platform automatically parses full-text research articles to extract structured trial information, translates user queries into structured database searches, and provides an attributed question-answering system that generates evidence-grounded answers linked to specific source sentences. We demonstrate its utility through a user study involving clinicians, clinical researchers, and PhD students of pharmaceutical sciences and nursing, and a systematic automatic evaluation of its information extraction and question answering capabilities.

title: Integrating Delay-Absorption Capability into Flight Departure Delay Prediction
summary: Accurately forecasting flight departure delays is essential for improving operational efficiency and mitigating the cascading disruptions that propagate through tightly coupled aircraft rotations. Traditional machine learning approaches often treat upstream delays as static variables, overlooking the dynamic recovery processes that determine whether a delay is absorbed or transmitted to subsequent legs. This study introduces a two-stage machine learning framework that explicitly models delay-absorption behavior and incorporates it into downstream delay prediction. In Stage I, a CatBoost classifier estimates the probability that a flight successfully absorbs an upstream delay based on operational, temporal, and meteorological features. This probability, termed AbsorbScore, quantifies airport- and flight-specific resilience to delay propagation. In Stage II, an XGBoost classifier integrates AbsorbScore with schedule, weather, and congestion indicators to predict whether a flight will depart more than 15 minutes late. Using U.S. domestic flight and NOAA weather data from Summer 2023, the proposed framework achieves substantial improvements over baseline models, increasing ROC-AUC from 0.865 to 0.898 and enhancing precision to 89.2% in identifying delayed flights. The results demonstrate that modeling delay absorption as an intermediate mechanism significantly improves predictive performance and yields interpretable insights into airport recovery dynamics, offering a practical foundation for data-driven delay management and proactive operational planning.

title: Animal Re-Identification on Microcontrollers
summary: Camera-based animal re-identification (Animal Re-ID) can support wildlife monitoring and precision livestock management in large outdoor environments with limited wireless connectivity. In these settings, inference must run directly on collar tags or low-power edge nodes built around microcontrollers (MCUs), yet most Animal Re-ID models are designed for workstations or servers and are too large for devices with small memory and low-resolution inputs. We propose an on-device framework. First, we characterise the gap between state-of-the-art Animal Re-ID models and MCU-class hardware, showing that straightforward knowledge distillation from large teachers offers limited benefit once memory and input resolution are constrained. Second, guided by this analysis, we design a high-accuracy Animal Re-ID architecture by systematically scaling a CNN-based MobileNetV2 backbone for low-resolution inputs. Third, we evaluate the framework with a real-world dataset and introduce a data-efficient fine-tuning strategy to enable fast adaptation with just three images per animal identity at a new site. Across six public Animal Re-ID datasets, our compact model achieves competitive retrieval accuracy while reducing model size by over two orders of magnitude. On a self-collected cattle dataset, the deployed model performs fully on-device inference with only a small accuracy drop and unchanged Top-1 accuracy relative to its cluster version. We demonstrate that practical, adaptable Animal Re-ID is achievable on MCU-class devices, paving the way for scalable deployment in real field environments.

title: Bounding the Minimal Current Harmonic Distortion in Optimal Modulation of Single-Phase Power Converters
summary: Optimal pulse patterns (OPPs) are a modulation technique in which a switching signal is computed offline through an optimization process that accounts for selected performance criteria, such as current harmonic distortion. The optimization determines both the switching angles (i.e., switching times) and the pattern structure (i.e., the sequence of voltage levels). This optimization task is a challenging mixed-integer nonconvex problem, involving integer-valued voltage levels and trigono metric nonlinearities in both the objective and the constraints. We address this challenge by reinterpreting OPP design as a periodic mode-selecting optimal control problem of a hybrid system, where selecting angles and levels corresponds to choosing jump times in a transition graph. This time-domain formulation enables the direct use of convex-relaxation techniques from optimal control, producing a hierarchy of semidefinite programs that lower-bound the minimal achievable harmonic distortion and scale subquadratically with the number of converter levels and switching angles. Numerical results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approachs

title: Error-Resilient Semantic Communication for Speech Transmission over Packet-Loss Networks
summary: Real-time speech communication over wireless networks remains challenging, as conventional channel protection mechanisms cannot effectively counter packet loss under stringent bandwidth and latency constraints. Semantic communication has emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing the robustness of speech transmission by means of joint source-channel coding (JSCC). However, its cross-layer design hinders practical deployment due to the incompatibility with existing digital communication systems. In this case, the robustness of speech communication is consequently evaluated primarily by the error-resilience to packet loss over wireless networks. To address these challenges, we propose \emph{Glaris}, a generative latent-prior-based resilient speech semantic communication framework that performs resilient speech coding in the generative latent space. Generative latent priors enable high-quality packet loss concealment (PLC) at the receiver side, well-balancing semantic consistency and reconstruction fidelity. Additionally, an integrated error resilience mechanism is designed to mitigate the error propagation and improve the effectiveness of PLC. Compared with traditional packet-level forward error correction (FEC) strategies, our new method achieves enhanced robustness over dynamic wireless networks while reducing redundancy overhead significantly. Experimental results on the LibriSpeech dataset demonstrate that \emph{Glaris} consistently outperforms existing error-resilient codecs, achieving JSCC-level robustness while maintaining seamless compatibility with existing systems, and it also strikes a favorable balance between transmission efficiency and speech reconstruction quality.

AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Glaris的基于生成式潜在先验的弹性语义通信框架，旨在解决现有语义通信系统因跨层设计导致的兼容性问题，并提升实时语音在丢包网络中的鲁棒性。Glaris通过在潜在空间中编码和利用生成式先验进行高质量的丢包隐藏（PLC），同时集成错误弹性机制，实现了与联合信源-信道编码（JSCC）相当的鲁棒性，显著降低了冗余开销，并保证了与现有数字通信系统的兼容性。

title: Evaluating Vulnerabilities of Connected Vehicles Under Cyber Attacks by Attack-Defense Tree
comments: 6 Pages, International Conference on Computing, Networking and Communication (ICNC), Maui, Hawaii, USA, 2026
summary: Connected vehicles represent a key enabler of intelligent transportation systems, where vehicles are equipped with advanced communication, sensing, and computing technologies to interact not only with one another but also with surrounding infrastructures and the environment. Through continuous data exchange, such vehicles are capable of enhancing road safety, improving traffic efficiency, and ensuring more reliable mobility services. Further, when these capabilities are integrated with advanced automation technologies, the concept essentially evolves into connected and autonomous vehicles (CAVs). While connected vehicles primarily focus on seamless information sharing, autonomous vehicles are mainly dependent on advanced perception, decision-making, and control mechanisms to operate with minimal or without human intervention. However, as a result of connectivity, an adversary with malicious intentions might be able to compromise successfully by breaching the system components of CAVs. In this paper, we present an attack-tree based methodology for evaluating cyber security vulnerabilities in CAVs. In particular, we utilize the attack-defense tree formulation to systematically assess attack-leaf vulnerabilities, and before analyzing the vulnerability indices, we also define a measure of vulnerabilities, which is based on existing cyber security threats and corresponding defensive countermeasures.

AI.title_translation: 基于攻防树的网联车辆网络攻击漏洞评估
AI.tldr: 网联自动驾驶车辆（CAVs）易受网络攻击。本文提出了一种基于攻防树的方法，用以系统评估CAVs的网络安全漏洞，并定义了新的漏洞衡量指标。
AI.motivation: 网联自动驾驶车辆（CAVs）的互联性虽然提高了交通效率和安全性，但也带来了网络安全风险，恶意攻击者可能通过破坏CAVs的系统组件而成功侵入。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于攻击树的方法，具体采用了攻防树（Attack-Defense Tree, ADT）模型来系统评估攻击叶节点的漏洞。同时，基于现有的网络安全威胁和相应的防御对策，定义了一种漏洞衡量指标。
AI.translation: 网联车辆是智能交通系统的关键推动力，它们配备了先进的通信、传感和计算技术，不仅可以相互交互，还可以与周围的基础设施和环境进行交互。通过持续的数据交换，此类车辆能够提高道路安全性、改善交通效率并确保更可靠的移动服务。此外，当这些能力与先进的自动化技术相结合时，这一概念本质上就演变为网联自动驾驶车辆（CAVs）。虽然网联车辆主要侧重于无缝信息共享，但自动驾驶车辆主要依赖先进的感知、决策和控制机制，以最少或无需人工干预的方式运行。然而，由于互联性，具有恶意意图的攻击者可能通过破坏CAVs的系统组件而成功侵入。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于攻击树的方法，用于评估CAVs中的网络安全漏洞。特别是，我们利用攻防树的公式来系统地评估攻击叶节点的漏洞，并且在分析漏洞指数之前，我们还定义了一种漏洞衡量指标，该指标基于现有的网络安全威胁和相应的防御对策。
AI.summary: 网联自动驾驶车辆（CAVs）因其互联性而面临严重的网络攻击风险。本文提出了一种基于攻防树（ADT）的方法论，旨在系统地评估CAVs中的网络安全漏洞。该方法首先基于现有的网络安全威胁和防御措施定义了漏洞衡量指标，然后利用攻防树模型对攻击叶节点的漏洞进行系统评估。
AI.keywords: 网联车辆, 网络攻击, 攻防树, 漏洞评估
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将攻防树（ADT）这一形式化模型应用于网联自动驾驶车辆（CAVs）的网络安全评估，解决了互联性带来的关键安全挑战。尤其重要的是，它定义了一种基于现有威胁和防御对策的漏洞衡量指标，使漏洞评估从定性分析转向了系统化的量化评估。

title: High-Performance Dual-Arm Task and Motion Planning for Tabletop Rearrangement
summary: We propose Synchronous Dual-Arm Rearrangement Planner (SDAR), a task and motion planning (TAMP) framework for tabletop rearrangement, where two robot arms equipped with 2-finger grippers must work together in close proximity to rearrange objects whose start and goal configurations are strongly entangled. To tackle such challenges, SDAR tightly knit together its dependency-driven task planner (SDAR-T) and synchronous dual-arm motion planner (SDAR-M), to intelligently sift through a large number of possible task and motion plans. Specifically, SDAR-T applies a simple yet effective strategy to decompose the global object dependency graph induced by the rearrangement task, to produce more optimal dual-arm task plans than solutions derived from optimal task plans for a single arm. Leveraging state-of-the-art GPU SIMD-based motion planning tools, SDAR-M employs a layered motion planning strategy to sift through many task plans for the best synchronous dual-arm motion plan while ensuring high levels of success rate. Comprehensive evaluation demonstrates that SDAR delivers a 100% success rate in solving complex, non-monotone, long-horizon tabletop rearrangement tasks with solution quality far exceeding the previous state-of-the-art. Experiments on two UR-5e arms further confirm SDAR directly and reliably transfers to robot hardware.

AI.title_translation: 高性能双臂任务与运动规划用于桌面重排
AI.tldr: 本文提出了同步双臂重排规划器（SDAR），这是一个用于复杂桌面重排任务的TAMP框架。它紧密结合了依赖驱动的任务规划器（SDAR-T）和同步运动规划器（SDAR-M），实现了100%的成功率，并在真实UR-5e机器人上得到了验证。
AI.motivation: 解决双臂机器人进行桌面重排时，由于两个机械臂在近距离工作以及物体初始和目标配置高度纠缠而带来的复杂任务与运动规划挑战。
AI.method: 提出了同步双臂重排规划器（SDAR），该框架紧密结合了依赖驱动的任务规划器（SDAR-T）和同步双臂运动规划器（SDAR-M）。SDAR-T通过分解全局物体依赖图来生成更优的双臂任务计划。SDAR-M利用先进的基于GPU SIMD的运动规划工具和分层运动规划策略，筛选出最佳的同步双臂运动计划，确保高成功率。
AI.result: 在解决复杂的、非单调的、长时程的桌面重排任务中，SDAR实现了100%的成功率，解决方案质量远超现有技术水平。实验证实SDAR可以直接可靠地转移到UR-5e机器人硬件上。
AI.translation: 我们提出了同步双臂重排规划器（SDAR），这是一个用于桌面重排的任务与运动规划（TAMP）框架。在该框架中，两台配备双指夹持器的机械臂必须在近距离协同工作，以重新排列起始和目标配置高度纠缠的物体。为了应对这些挑战，SDAR紧密结合了其依赖驱动的任务规划器（SDAR-T）和同步双臂运动规划器（SDAR-M），从而智能地筛选出大量的可能任务和运动计划。具体而言，SDAR-T应用了一种简单而有效的策略来分解由重排任务引起的全局物体依赖图，从而产生比由单臂最优任务计划衍生的解决方案更优的双臂任务计划。SDAR-M利用最先进的基于GPU SIMD的运动规划工具，采用分层运动规划策略，在筛选许多任务计划以获得最佳同步双臂运动计划的同时，确保高成功率。全面的评估表明，SDAR在解决复杂的、非单调的、长时程的桌面重排任务中实现了100%的成功率，其解决方案质量远远超过了以前的现有技术水平。在两台UR-5e机械臂上的实验进一步证实了SDAR可以直接可靠地转移到机器人硬件上。
AI.summary: SDAR是一种高性能的双臂任务与运动规划（TAMP）框架，专为解决物体高度纠缠的复杂桌面重排任务而设计。它通过将依赖驱动的任务规划器（SDAR-T）与同步双臂运动规划器（SDAR-M）紧密集成，实现了任务分解和高效的同步运动规划。该方法在复杂任务中实现了100%的成功率，并被证明可可靠地应用于实际机器人硬件。
AI.keywords: 双臂, 任务与运动规划, 桌面重排, 同步规划, SDAR
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新点在于其提出的SDAR框架，特别是它如何紧密集成和优化任务规划（SDAR-T）与运动规划（SDAR-M）以应对双臂协作中的高度耦合和依赖性问题。通过分解全局物体依赖图来生成优于单臂方案的双臂任务计划，是解决复杂重排任务的关键突破。利用GPU SIMD技术进行同步运动规划，保证了高效率和100%的成功率，使其成为该领域内具有重要实际应用价值的先进技术。

title: Duct boundary conditions for incompressible fluid flows: finite element discretizations and parameter estimation in coronary blood flow
summary:
3D-0D coupled flow models are widely used across many application fields but remain challenging to solve. Implicit coupling introduces non-local terms, whereas explicit coupling results in only conditionally stable schemes. Furthermore, incorporating inertial effects alongside viscous resistance enlarges the parameter space, making calibration more difficult.
  In this work, we propose a new type of boundary condition based on the method of asymptotic partial decomposition of a domain (MAPDD), which we denote as the Duct Boundary Condition (DuBC). This approach enables the incorporation of geometrically reduced domains as a boundary term with only local coupling in the implicit case. Moreover, the DuBC accounts for both viscous and inertial effects simultaneously using a single physical parameter. Additionally, we derive a fractional-step time-marching scheme including the DuBC. We demonstrate the features of the DuBC in coronary artery blood flow simulations, including sequential parameter estimation from noisy velocity data.

AI.title_translation: 不可压缩流体流动的管道边界条件：冠状动脉血流中的有限元离散化和参数估计
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的管道边界条件（DuBC），它基于MAPDD方法，解决了3D-0D耦合模型中非局部耦合和不稳定的问题。DuBC实现了隐式局部耦合，并能用单个参数同时处理粘性和惯性效应。该方法已成功应用于冠状动脉血流模拟和参数估计。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D-0D耦合流模型难以求解：隐式耦合引入非局部项，显式耦合方案仅条件稳定。此外，同时考虑粘性阻力和惯性效应会扩大参数空间，使模型校准更加困难。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于域渐近部分分解方法（MAPDD）的新型边界条件，称为管道边界条件（DuBC）。DuBC将几何简化域作为边界项纳入，在隐式情况下实现了局部耦合。该条件使用单个物理参数同时考虑粘性和惯性效应。此外，还推导了一个包含DuBC的分步时间推进方案（fractional-step time-marching scheme）。
AI.result: 在冠状动脉血流模拟中展示了DuBC的特性，包括从带噪声的速度数据中进行序列参数估计。
AI.translation: 3D-0D耦合流动模型在许多应用领域中被广泛使用，但其求解仍然具有挑战性。隐式耦合引入了非局部项，而显式耦合则导致仅条件稳定的方案。此外，将惯性效应与粘性阻力一同纳入会扩大参数空间，使校准更加困难。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于域渐近部分分解方法（MAPDD）的新型边界条件，我们称之为管道边界条件（DuBC）。这种方法使得将几何简化域作为边界项纳入成为可能，且在隐式情况下仅需局部耦合。此外，DuBC使用单个物理参数同时考虑了粘性和惯性效应。此外，我们还推导了一个包含DuBC的分步时间推进方案。我们展示了DuBC在冠状动脉血流模拟中的特性，包括从带噪声的速度数据中进行序列参数估计。
AI.summary: 本文针对3D-0D耦合流模型中现有的非局部耦合和参数校准困难问题，提出了一种基于域渐近部分分解方法（MAPDD）的新型管道边界条件（DuBC）。DuBC实现了隐式局部耦合，并能用单个物理参数同时描述粘性和惯性效应。研究者还推导了相应的分步时间推进方案，并通过在冠状动脉血流模拟中进行参数估计，验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 管道边界条件, 3D-0D耦合模型, 有限元离散化, 冠状动脉血流, 参数估计
AI.comments: 该论文的主要创新在于提出了管道边界条件（DuBC），这是一种能够解决3D-0D耦合流模型中关键挑战（非局部性、不稳定性和参数空间大）的新型边界条件。DuBC通过实现隐式局部耦合，并用单一参数捕获复杂的粘性和惯性效应，显著简化了计算复杂性和参数校准过程。将其应用于冠状动脉血流模拟，显示了其在生物医学工程和计算流体力学中的实际应用潜力。

title: MobileFineTuner: A Unified End-to-End Framework for Fine-Tuning LLMs on Mobile Phones
summary: Mobile phones are the most ubiquitous end devices, generating vast amounts of human-authored data and serving as the primary platform for end-side applications. As high-quality public data for large language models (LLMs) approaches exhaustion, on-device fine-tuning provides an opportunity to leverage private user data while preserving privacy. However, existing approaches are predominantly simulation-based or rely on IoT devices and PCs, leaving commodity mobile phones largely unexplored. A key gap is the absence of an open-source framework that enables practical LLM fine-tuning on mobile phones. We present MobileFineTuner, a unified open-source framework that enables end-to-end LLM fine-tuning directly on commodity mobile phones. MobileFineTuner is designed for efficiency, scalability, and usability, supporting full-parameters fine-tuning (Full-FT) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT). To address the memory and energy limitations inherent to mobile phones, we introduce system-level optimizations including parameter sharding, gradient accumulation, and energy-aware computation scheduling. We demonstrate the practicality of MobileFineTuner by fine-tuning GPT-2, Gemma 3, and Qwen 2.5 on real mobile phones. Extensive experiments and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of the proposed optimizations and establish MobileFineTuner as a viable foundation for future research on on-device LLM training.

AI.title_translation: MobileFineTuner：一个用于在移动手机上微调大型语言模型的统一端到端框架
AI.tldr: 提出了MobileFineTuner，这是一个开源的端到端框架，允许在普通手机上直接微调LLM。它通过参数分片和能源感知调度等系统优化，解决了内存和能耗限制，并被证明在真实手机上微调GPT-2、Gemma 3和Qwen 2.5是可行的。
AI.motivation: 移动手机是主要的终端设备，拥有大量私人用户数据；高质量的公共LLM数据接近枯竭；现有方法主要基于模拟或依赖IoT/PC，缺乏在普通手机上进行实用LLM微调的开源框架。
AI.method: 提出了MobileFineTuner，一个统一的开源端到端框架，支持全参数微调（Full-FT）和参数高效微调（PEFT）。为解决移动设备的内存和能源限制，引入了系统级优化，包括参数分片、梯度累积和能源感知计算调度。
AI.result: 成功在真实的移动手机上微调了GPT-2、Gemma 3和Qwen 2.5模型。广泛的实验和消融研究证实了所提出优化的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MobileFineTuner为未来设备端LLM训练研究奠定了可行的基础。
AI.translation: 移动手机是最普遍的终端设备，生成了大量的由人类创作的数据，并作为终端侧应用的主要平台。随着高质量的公共大型语言模型（LLM）数据接近枯竭，设备端微调为利用私人用户数据同时保护隐私提供了机会。然而，现有方法主要基于模拟或依赖于物联网设备和个人电脑，使得普通移动手机在很大程度上未被探索。一个关键的空白是缺乏一个能够实现移动手机上实用LLM微调的开源框架。我们提出了MobileFineTuner，一个统一的开源框架，可以直接在普通移动手机上实现端到端LLM微调。MobileFineTuner的设计注重效率、可扩展性和可用性，支持全参数微调（Full-FT）和参数高效微调（PEFT）。为了解决移动手机固有的内存和能源限制，我们引入了系统级优化，包括参数分片、梯度累积和能源感知计算调度。我们通过在真实的移动手机上微调GPT-2、Gemma 3和Qwen 2.5来证明MobileFineTuner的实用性。广泛的实验和消融研究验证了所提出优化的有效性，并将MobileFineTuner确立为未来设备端LLM训练研究的可行基础。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了MobileFineTuner，一个统一的开源框架，旨在解决在普通移动手机上进行大型语言模型（LLM）微调的挑战。鉴于公共数据枯竭和隐私保护需求，设备端微调至关重要。MobileFineTuner支持Full-FT和PEFT，并通过参数分片、梯度累积和能源感知调度等系统级优化来克服移动设备的内存和能源限制。实验证明该框架能够成功微调GPT-2、Gemma 3和Qwen 2.5等模型，为设备端LLM训练提供了实用基础。
AI.keywords: 移动端微调, LLM, MobileFineTuner, 设备端训练, 参数高效微调
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于填补了在普通移动手机上进行大型语言模型（LLM）实际微调的空白。考虑到移动设备的普及性、生成数据量以及对用户隐私保护的日益重视，该框架具有重要的实用价值。通过引入参数分片、梯度累积和能源感知调度等系统级优化，作者有效地解决了移动设备固有的资源限制（内存和能耗），这是使设备端LLM训练从理论走向实践的关键一步。MobileFineTuner作为开源框架的发布，有望推动“边缘AI”和个性化LLM模型的快速发展。

title: Secure or Suspect? Investigating Package Hallucinations of Shell Command in Original and Quantized LLMs
summary:
Large Language Models for code (LLMs4Code) are increasingly used to generate software artifacts, including library and package recommendations in languages such as Go. However, recent evidence shows that LLMs frequently hallucinate package names or generate dependencies containing known security vulnerabilities, posing significant risks to developers and downstream software supply chains. At the same time, quantization has become a widely adopted technique to reduce inference cost and enable deployment of LLMs on resource-constrained environments. Despite its popularity, little is known about how quantization affects the correctness and security of LLM-generated software dependencies while generating shell commands for package installation.
  In this work, we conduct the first systematic empirical study of the impact of quantization on package hallucination and vulnerability risks in LLM-generated Go packages. We evaluate five Qwen model sizes under full-precision, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization across three datasets (SO, MBPP, and paraphrase). Our results show that quantization substantially increases the package hallucination rate (PHR), with 4-bit models exhibiting the most severe degradation. We further find that even among the correctly generated packages, the vulnerability presence rate (VPR) rises as precision decreases, indicating elevated security risk in lower-precision models. Finally, our analysis of hallucinated outputs reveals that most fabricated packages resemble realistic URL-based Go module paths, such as most commonly malformed or non-existent GitHub and golang.org repositories, highlighting a systematic pattern in how LLMs hallucinate dependencies. Overall, our findings provide actionable insights into the reliability and security implications of deploying quantized LLMs for code generation and dependency recommendation.

AI.title_translation: 安全还是可疑？探究原始和量化LLM中Shell命令的包幻觉问题
AI.tldr: 研究发现，对LLM进行量化（尤其是4位量化）会显著增加其生成Go语言包依赖时的包幻觉率和安全漏洞存在率，对软件供应链安全构成风险。
AI.motivation: 代码大型语言模型（LLMs4Code）生成的包推荐存在幻觉和安全漏洞风险。量化技术虽然流行，但其对LLM生成Go语言包的正确性和安全性（特别是包安装shell命令）的影响未知，需要系统研究。
AI.method: 采用系统实证研究方法，评估五种尺寸的Qwen模型，分别在全精度、8位和4位量化下，使用三个数据集（SO、MBPP和paraphrase）来研究量化对Go语言包幻觉率（PHR）和漏洞存在率（VPR）的影响。
AI.result: 量化大幅提高了包幻觉率（PHR），4位模型表现出最严重的性能下降。随着模型精度降低，正确生成的包的漏洞存在率（VPR）也随之增加。幻觉出的包大多模仿真实的URL格式Go模块路径，如畸形或不存在的GitHub和golang.org仓库。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为部署量化LLM进行代码生成和依赖推荐的可靠性和安全影响提供了可操作的见解。
AI.translation:
用于代码的大型语言模型（LLMs4Code）正越来越多地用于生成软件构件，包括Go等语言中的库和包推荐。然而，最近的证据表明，LLM经常会幻觉出包名或生成包含已知安全漏洞的依赖项，给开发人员和下游软件供应链带来重大风险。与此同时，量化已成为一种广泛采用的技术，用于降低推理成本，并使LLM能够在资源受限的环境中部署。尽管量化很受欢迎，但关于其如何影响LLM在生成用于包安装的shell命令时，所生成的软件依赖项的正确性和安全性的信息却知之甚少。
在本工作中，我们首次对量化对LLM生成的Go包中的包幻觉和漏洞风险的影响进行了系统的实证研究。我们评估了五种Qwen模型尺寸在全精度、8位和4位量化下的性能，并使用了三个数据集（SO、MBPP和paraphrase）。我们的结果显示，量化大幅提高了包幻觉率（PHR），其中4位模型的退化最为严重。我们进一步发现，即使在正确生成的包中，漏洞存在率（VPR）也随着精度降低而上升，这表明低精度模型的安全风险有所提高。最后，我们对幻觉输出的分析揭示，大多数伪造的包类似于逼真的基于URL的Go模块路径，例如最常见的畸形或不存在的GitHub和golang.org仓库，这突出表明了LLM幻觉依赖项的系统模式。总的来说，我们的发现为部署量化LLM进行代码生成和依赖推荐的可靠性和安全影响提供了可操作的见解。
AI.summary: 代码大模型在生成软件依赖时容易出现不安全或虚假的包推荐。本研究首次系统探究了量化（8位和4位）对Qwen模型生成Go语言包shell命令时的包幻觉和安全风险的影响。结果表明，量化显著提高了包幻觉率和漏洞存在率，其中4位模型的退化最为严重。幻觉输出遵循可识别的系统模式，这些发现对安全部署量化LLM至关重要。
AI.keywords: 量化, 包幻觉, 软件供应链, LLM4Code, Go语言
AI.comments: 这项研究非常及时且具有高度相关性，它解决了LLM效率（量化）与软件供应链安全之间的关键交叉问题。其创新点在于首次系统地实证研究了量化模型中包幻觉和漏洞风险的影响，明确揭示了降低部署成本与安全/正确性之间的权衡。研究结果，特别是4位量化会导致安全性能大幅下降的发现，对实际部署者提供了明确的警示。此外，发现幻觉出的包遵循系统模式，模仿真实的URL路径，为未来针对性防御提供了方向。

title: Blur2Sharp: Human Novel Pose and View Synthesis with Generative Prior Refinement
summary: The creation of lifelike human avatars capable of realistic pose variation and viewpoint flexibility remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision and graphics. Current approaches typically yield either geometrically inconsistent multi-view images or sacrifice photorealism, resulting in blurry outputs under diverse viewing angles and complex motions. To address these issues, we propose Blur2Sharp, a novel framework integrating 3D-aware neural rendering and diffusion models to generate sharp, geometrically consistent novel-view images from only a single reference view. Our method employs a dual-conditioning architecture: initially, a Human NeRF model generates geometrically coherent multi-view renderings for target poses, explicitly encoding 3D structural guidance. Subsequently, a diffusion model conditioned on these renderings refines the generated images, preserving fine-grained details and structural fidelity. We further enhance visual quality through hierarchical feature fusion, incorporating texture, normal, and semantic priors extracted from parametric SMPL models to simultaneously improve global coherence and local detail accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Blur2Sharp consistently surpasses state-of-the-art techniques in both novel pose and view generation tasks, particularly excelling under challenging scenarios involving loose clothing and occlusions.

AI.title_translation: Blur2Sharp：基于生成先验优化的新型人体姿态与视角合成
AI.tldr: 提出Blur2Sharp框架，结合3D-aware NeRF和扩散模型，仅用单张参考图就能生成清晰、几何一致的新型人体姿态和视角图像，优于现有SOTA方法，尤其擅长处理宽松衣物和遮挡。
AI.motivation: 当前方法在生成具有逼真姿态变化和视角灵活性的类人形象时，要么产生几何不一致的多视角图像，要么牺牲照片真实感，导致在复杂运动和多样视角下输出模糊。
AI.method: 提出Blur2Sharp框架，整合了3D感知神经渲染（Human NeRF）和扩散模型。方法采用双重条件架构：Human NeRF为目标姿态生成几何一致的多视角渲染图，提供3D结构指导；随后，一个以这些渲染图为条件的扩散模型对图像进行细化。此外，通过分层特征融合，利用从参数化SMPL模型提取的纹理、法线和语义先验来提高全局一致性和局部细节精度。
AI.result: 广泛的实验证明，Blur2Sharp在新型姿态和视角生成任务中始终超越最先进的技术，尤其在处理涉及宽松衣物和遮挡等挑战性场景时表现出色。
AI.translation: 创建能够逼真改变姿态和灵活调整视角的类人形象，仍然是计算机视觉和图形学中的一个基本挑战。目前的常用方法要么产生几何不一致的多视角图像，要么牺牲照片真实感，导致在多样视角和复杂运动下输出模糊。为解决这些问题，我们提出了Blur2Sharp，这是一个创新的框架，它整合了3D感知神经渲染和扩散模型，仅从单个参考视角生成清晰、几何一致的新视角图像。我们的方法采用双重条件架构：首先，一个Human NeRF模型为目标姿态生成几何一致的多视角渲染图，明确编码了3D结构指导。随后，一个以这些渲染图为条件的扩散模型对生成的图像进行细化，以保持精细细节和结构保真度。我们通过分层特征融合进一步提高了视觉质量，融合了从参数化SMPL模型中提取的纹理、法线和语义先验，以同时改善全局一致性和局部细节精度。广泛的实验证明，Blur2Sharp在新型姿态和视角生成任务中始终超越最先进的技术，尤其在处理涉及宽松衣物和遮挡等挑战性场景时表现出色。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Blur2Sharp框架，用于从单个参考视图合成清晰、几何一致的新型人体姿态和视角图像。该方法通过结合3D感知神经渲染（Human NeRF）和扩散模型实现双重条件架构，其中NeRF提供3D结构指导，扩散模型负责细节细化。同时，通过融合SMPL模型提取的纹理、法线和语义先验，进一步优化了视觉质量。实验证明该方法在挑战性场景下优于现有SOTA技术。
AI.keywords: 人体姿态合成, 视角合成, 神经辐射场, 扩散模型, SMPL模型
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于有效地结合了两种强大的生成范式：3D感知神经辐射场（Human NeRF，用于几何一致性）和扩散模型（用于高保真细节和锐度），解决了现有方法在几何一致性与照片真实感之间难以平衡的问题。通过引入SMPL模型的结构先验（纹理、法线、语义）进行分层特征融合，进一步增强了对复杂场景（如宽松衣物和遮挡）的处理能力。这种“结构引导生成优化”的思路对于通用人体重建和合成领域具有重要意义。

title: Correction of Decoupled Weight Decay
summary: Decoupled weight decay, solely responsible for the performance advantage of AdamW over Adam, has long been set to proportional to learning rate $γ$ without questioning. Some researchers have recently challenged such assumption and argued that decoupled weight decay should be set $\propto γ^2$ instead based on orthogonality arguments at steady state. To the contrary, we find that eliminating the contribution of the perpendicular component of the update to the weight norm leads to little change to the training dynamics. Instead, we derive that decoupled weight decay $\propto γ^2$ results in stable weight norm based on the simple assumption that updates become independent of the weights at steady state, regardless of the nature of the optimizer. Based on the same assumption, we derive and empirically verify that the Total Update Contribution (TUC) of a minibatch under the Scion optimizer is better characterized by the momentum-dependent effective learning rate whose optimal value transfers and we show that decoupled weight decay $\propto γ^2$ leads to stable weight and gradient norms and allows us to better control the training dynamics and improve the model performance.

AI.tldr: 传统解耦权重衰减 ($\propto \gamma$) 是错的，我们证明并验证了正确的设置应与学习率的平方 ($\propto \gamma^2$) 成正比，这能稳定权重和梯度范数，并显著提高模型性能。
AI.motivation: 解耦权重衰减（DWD）是AdamW优于Adam的关键，但其传统设置（与学习率$\gamma$成正比）受到挑战。一些研究认为应设置为$\propto \gamma^2$。本文旨在通过新的理论推导和实证验证，修正这一设置，以实现更稳定的训练动态和更优的模型性能。
AI.method: 理论推导：基于“在稳态下，更新与权重无关”的简单假设，推导出解耦权重衰减应与学习率的平方（$\gamma^2$）成正比，从而实现稳定的权重范数。同时，对Scion优化器下的总更新贡献（TUC）进行了经验验证。
AI.result: 消除更新中垂直分量对权重范数的贡献对训练动态影响很小。理论推导并经验验证了设置解耦权重衰减$\propto \gamma^2$能导致稳定的权重和梯度范数，允许更好地控制训练动态，并提高模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 解耦权重衰减应与学习率的平方成正比（$\propto \gamma^2$），而不是传统的与学习率成正比（$\propto \gamma$）。这一修正基于稳态下更新独立于权重的简单假设，能有效稳定权重和梯度范数，从而更好地控制训练动态并提高模型性能。
AI.translation: 解耦权重衰减是AdamW相对于Adam的性能优势的唯一原因，长期以来一直被设置为与学习率$\gamma$成正比，且从未受到质疑。最近，一些研究人员挑战了这一假设，并根据稳态下的正交性论证，认为解耦权重衰减应设置为$\propto \gamma^2$。与此相反，我们发现消除更新中垂直分量对权重范数的贡献对训练动态影响甚微。相反，我们推导得出，基于“在稳态下更新独立于权重”这一简单假设（无论优化器性质如何），解耦权重衰减$\propto \gamma^2$能带来稳定的权重范数。基于相同的假设，我们推导并经验验证了在Scion优化器下，一个最小批次的“总更新贡献”（Total Update Contribution, TUC）更好地由依赖于动量的有效学习率来表征，其最优值可以迁移。我们证明了解耦权重衰减$\propto \gamma^2$能带来稳定的权重和梯度范数，并允许我们更好地控制训练动态和提高模型性能。
AI.summary: 本文修正了长期以来被默认采用的解耦权重衰减（DWD）设置。传统DWD与学习率$\gamma$成正比，但本文通过理论推导，基于“稳态更新独立于权重”的假设，证明了DWD应与学习率的平方$\gamma^2$成正比。经验验证表明，这一$\propto \gamma^2$的设置能有效稳定权重和梯度范数，更好地控制训练动态，并显著提高模型性能。
AI.keywords: 解耦权重衰减, AdamW, 学习率, 权重范数, 优化器
AI.comments: 本文的重要性在于对AdamW等现代优化器中核心正则化技术——解耦权重衰减（DWD）——进行了基础性的修正。它挑战了长期以来默认的$\propto \gamma$设置，并提供了基于“稳态更新独立性”这一更简单、更普适的理论框架来支持$\propto \gamma^2$的设置，而非基于复杂的正交性论证。这一修正对于确保训练稳定性（稳定的权重和梯度范数）和优化模型性能具有关键的实践意义，有助于改进超参数的控制和迁移。

title: PR-CapsNet: Pseudo-Riemannian Capsule Network with Adaptive Curvature Routing for Graph Learning
comments: To appear in WSDM 2026 (ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining)
summary: Capsule Networks (CapsNets) show exceptional graph representation capacity via dynamic routing and vectorized hierarchical representations, but they model the complex geometries of real\-world graphs poorly by fixed\-curvature space due to the inherent geodesical disconnectedness issues, leading to suboptimal performance. Recent works find that non\-Euclidean pseudo\-Riemannian manifolds provide specific inductive biases for embedding graph data, but how to leverage them to improve CapsNets is still underexplored. Here, we extend the Euclidean capsule routing into geodesically disconnected pseudo\-Riemannian manifolds and derive a Pseudo\-Riemannian Capsule Network (PR\-CapsNet), which models data in pseudo\-Riemannian manifolds of adaptive curvature, for graph representation learning. Specifically, PR\-CapsNet enhances the CapsNet with Adaptive Pseudo\-Riemannian Tangent Space Routing by utilizing pseudo\-Riemannian geometry. Unlike single\-curvature or subspace\-partitioning methods, PR\-CapsNet concurrently models hierarchical and cluster or cyclic graph structures via its versatile pseudo\-Riemannian metric. It first deploys Pseudo\-Riemannian Tangent Space Routing to decompose capsule states into spherical\-temporal and Euclidean\-spatial subspaces with diffeomorphic transformations. Then, an Adaptive Curvature Routing is developed to adaptively fuse features from different curvature spaces for complex graphs via a learnable curvature tensor with geometric attention from local manifold properties. Finally, a geometric properties\-preserved Pseudo\-Riemannian Capsule Classifier is developed to project capsule embeddings to tangent spaces and use curvature\-weighted softmax for classification. Extensive experiments on node and graph classification benchmarks show PR\-CapsNet outperforms SOTA models, validating PR\-CapsNet's strong representation power for complex graph structures.
comment: To appear in WSDM 2026 (ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining)

AI.title_translation: PR-CapsNet：具有自适应曲率路由的伪黎曼胶囊网络用于图学习
AI.tldr: PR-CapsNet将胶囊网络（CapsNets）扩展到自适应曲率的伪黎曼流形中，并引入自适应曲率路由，以解决现有CapsNets在处理复杂图结构时因固定曲率空间导致的测地线不连通问题，在图分类任务上取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的胶囊网络（CapsNets）使用固定曲率空间建模图数据，这导致了固有的测地线不连通问题，从而无法很好地建模真实世界图的复杂几何结构，性能不佳。同时，如何利用非欧几里得伪黎曼流形来改进CapsNets仍有待探索。
AI.method: 提出伪黎曼胶囊网络（PR-CapsNet），将欧几里得胶囊路由扩展到测地线不连通的伪黎曼流形中。具体方法包括：1) 部署伪黎曼切空间路由，通过微分同胚变换将胶囊状态分解为球形-时间和欧几里得-空间子空间；2) 开发自适应曲率路由，通过可学习的曲率张量和几何注意力自适应地融合来自不同曲率空间的特征；3) 开发几何特性保留的伪黎曼胶囊分类器，将胶囊嵌入投影到切空间并使用曲率加权softmax进行分类。
AI.result: 在节点和图分类基准测试中，PR-CapsNet的性能优于现有SOTA模型。
AI.conclusion: PR-CapsNet验证了其对复杂图结构的强大表示能力。
AI.translation: 胶囊网络（CapsNets）通过动态路由和向量化的分层表示展现出卓越的图表示能力，但由于固有的测地线不连通问题，它们通过固定曲率空间对真实世界图的复杂几何结构建模不佳，导致性能欠佳。最近的研究发现，非欧几里得伪黎曼流形为嵌入图数据提供了特定的归纳偏置，但如何利用它们来改进CapsNets仍有待探索。在此，我们将欧几里得胶囊路由扩展到测地线不连通的伪黎曼流形中，并推导出了伪黎曼胶囊网络（PR-CapsNet），它在自适应曲率的伪黎曼流形中建模数据，用于图表示学习。具体来说，PR-CapsNet利用伪黎曼几何增强了具有自适应伪黎曼切空间路由的CapsNet。与单曲率或子空间划分方法不同，PR-CapsNet通过其多功能的伪黎曼度量同时建模了分层、集群或循环的图结构。它首先部署伪黎曼切空间路由，通过微分同胚变换将胶囊状态分解为球形-时间和欧几里得-空间子空间。然后，开发了一种自适应曲率路由，通过可学习的曲率张量和来自局部流形属性的几何注意力，自适应地融合来自不同曲率空间的特征，以处理复杂图。最后，开发了一种保留几何特性的伪黎曼胶囊分类器，将胶囊嵌入投影到切空间并使用曲率加权的softmax进行分类。在节点和图分类基准上的大量实验表明，PR-CapsNet优于SOTA模型，验证了PR-CapsNet对复杂图结构的强大表示能力。
AI.summary: PR-CapsNet旨在解决标准胶囊网络（CapsNets）在图学习中因固定曲率空间导致的几何结构建模能力不足的问题。通过将欧几里得胶囊路由扩展到自适应曲率的伪黎曼流形中，PR-CapsNet提供了一种多功能的度量，能够同时建模分层、集群和循环图结构。该模型引入了伪黎曼切空间路由进行状态分解，并开发了自适应曲率路由，利用几何注意力和可学习的曲率张量融合不同曲率空间的特征。实验证明，PR-CapsNet在节点和图分类任务上优于现有SOTA模型。
AI.keywords: 胶囊网络, 图学习, 伪黎曼流形, 自适应曲率路由
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将伪黎曼流形几何（一种非欧几里得几何）与胶囊网络（CapsNets）相结合，用于图学习。它解决了传统CapsNets在固定曲率空间中对复杂图结构建模的局限性（测地线不连通问题）。尤为重要的是，PR-CapsNet采用了自适应曲率路由，通过可学习的曲率张量和几何注意力，使其能够同时捕获分层、集群和循环等多样化的图结构，这比单一曲率或简单子空间划分的方法更具灵活性和表示力。

title: Any Old Tom, Dick or Harry: The Citation Impact of First Name Genderedness
summary: This paper attempts a first analysis of citation distributions based on the genderedness of authors' first name. Following the extraction of first name and sex data from all human entity triplets contained in Wikidata, a first name genderedness table is first created based on compiled sex frequencies, then merged with bibliometric data from eponymous, US-affiliated authors. Comparisons of various cumulative distributions show that citation concentrations fluctuations are highest at the opposite ends of the genderedness spectrum, as authors with very feminine and masculine first names respectively get a lower and higher share of citations for every article published, irrespective of their contribution role.

AI.title_translation: 任何一个普通人（Tom, Dick或Harry）：名字性别倾向性对引文的影响
AI.tldr: 研究发现，名字性别倾向性与引文分布相关：名字非常女性化的作者获得的引文份额较低，而名字非常男性化的作者获得的引文份额较高，这种差异与作者的贡献角色无关。
AI.motivation: 首次尝试基于作者名字的性别倾向性来分析引文分布。
AI.method: 1. 从Wikidata的人类实体三元组中提取名字和性别数据。2. 根据性别的频率创建名字性别倾向性表。3. 将该表与同名、隶属于美国的作者的文献计量数据合并，并比较各种累积分布。
AI.result: 引文集中度的波动在性别倾向性谱系的两端最高。名字非常女性化的作者获得的引文份额较低，而名字非常男性化的作者获得的引文份额较高，且这种现象与作者的贡献角色无关。
AI.conclusion: 名字的性别倾向性（特别是处于极端时）对作者获得的引文份额有显著影响。
AI.translation: 本文首次尝试基于作者名字的性别倾向性来分析引文分布。首先，从Wikidata中包含的所有人类实体三元组中提取名字和性别数据，然后根据汇编的性别频率创建名字性别倾向性表，最后将其与同名、隶属于美国的作者的文献计量数据合并。对各种累积分布的比较表明，引文集中度的波动在性别倾向性谱系的两端最高，因为名字非常女性化和非常男性化的作者，无论其贡献角色如何，分别获得较低和较高的每篇文章引文份额。
AI.summary: 本研究首次探讨了作者名字的性别倾向性如何影响引文分布。研究人员从Wikidata提取名字和性别数据，构建名字性别倾向性表，并将其与美国作者的文献计量数据结合。结果显示，在性别倾向性的两极，引文集中度波动最大：名字非常女性化的作者获得的引文份额较低，而名字非常男性化的作者获得的引文份额较高，这种模式独立于作者的贡献角色。
AI.keywords: 名字性别倾向性, 引文分布, Wikidata, 文献计量学, 性别偏差
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于它是首次将作者名字的性别倾向性作为一个变量来分析引文分布，揭示了潜在的、与性别相关的学术认可偏差。其重要性在于，它提供了一种新的视角来理解学术界的偏见和引文集中现象，表明即使是名字的性别“感知”也能影响学术影响力。局限性可能在于数据仅限于“同名”和“隶属于美国”的作者，这可能限制了结果的普遍性。

title: VisKnow: Constructing Visual Knowledge Base for Object Understanding
summary: Understanding objects is fundamental to computer vision. Beyond object recognition that provides only a category label as typical output, in-depth object understanding represents a comprehensive perception of an object category, involving its components, appearance characteristics, inter-category relationships, contextual background knowledge, etc. Developing such capability requires sufficient multi-modal data, including visual annotations such as parts, attributes, and co-occurrences for specific tasks, as well as textual knowledge to support high-level tasks like reasoning and question answering. However, these data are generally task-oriented and not systematically organized enough to achieve the expected understanding of object categories. In response, we propose the Visual Knowledge Base that structures multi-modal object knowledge as graphs, and present a construction framework named VisKnow that extracts multi-modal, object-level knowledge for object understanding. This framework integrates enriched aligned text and image-source knowledge with region annotations at both object and part levels through a combination of expert design and large-scale model application. As a specific case study, we construct AnimalKB, a structured animal knowledge base covering 406 animal categories, which contains 22K textual knowledge triplets extracted from encyclopedic documents, 420K images, and corresponding region annotations. A series of experiments showcase how AnimalKB enhances object-level visual tasks such as zero-shot recognition and fine-grained VQA, and serves as challenging benchmarks for knowledge graph completion and part segmentation. Our findings highlight the potential of automatically constructing visual knowledge bases to advance visual understanding and its practical applications. The project page is available at https://vipl-vsu.github.io/VisKnow.

AI.title_translation: VisKnow：构建用于对象理解的视觉知识库
AI.tldr: 提出VisKnow框架来构建结构化的视觉知识库（如AnimalKB），以超越简单的对象识别，实现深入的对象理解。该知识库通过集成多模态数据和区域标注，有效提升了零样本识别和细粒度VQA等视觉任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的对象识别仅提供类别标签，无法实现深入的对象理解（包括组件、特征、关系、背景知识等）。现有多模态数据通常以任务为导向，缺乏系统性的组织来支持这种深入理解。
AI.method: 提出了“视觉知识库”（将多模态对象知识结构化为图）和“VisKnow”构建框架。该框架通过专家设计和大规模模型应用的结合，整合了丰富的对齐文本和图像源知识，以及对象和部件级别的区域标注。作为一个案例研究，构建了AnimalKB（涵盖406个动物类别，包含22K文本知识三元组和420K图像）。
AI.result: AnimalKB增强了对象级别的视觉任务，例如零样本识别和细粒度视觉问答（VQA）。它还可作为知识图谱补全和部件分割的挑战性基准。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了自动构建视觉知识库在推进视觉理解及其实际应用方面的潜力。
AI.translation: 理解对象是计算机视觉的基础。典型的对象识别仅提供类别标签作为输出，而深入的对象理解则代表对对象类别的全面感知，涉及其组件、外观特征、类别间关系、上下文背景知识等。开发这种能力需要足够的多模态数据，包括针对特定任务的视觉标注（如部件、属性和共现）以及支持推理和问答等高级任务的文本知识。然而，这些数据通常以任务为导向，缺乏系统性的组织，难以达到预期的对象类别理解水平。为此，我们提出了视觉知识库（Visual Knowledge Base），它将多模态对象知识结构化为图，并提出了一个名为VisKnow的构建框架，该框架提取用于对象理解的多模态、对象级知识。该框架通过专家设计和大规模模型应用的结合，将丰富的对齐文本和图像源知识与对象和部件级别的区域标注进行整合。作为一个具体的案例研究，我们构建了AnimalKB，这是一个结构化的动物知识库，涵盖406个动物类别，包含从百科文档中提取的22K文本知识三元组、420K图像以及相应的区域标注。一系列实验展示了AnimalKB如何增强零样本识别和细粒度视觉问答（VQA）等对象级视觉任务，并可作为知识图谱补全和部件分割的挑战性基准。我们的研究结果强调了自动构建视觉知识库在推进视觉理解及其实际应用方面的潜力。项目页面位于 https://vipl-vsu.github.io/VisKnow。
AI.summary: 本文提出了VisKnow框架，用于构建结构化的视觉知识库（Visual Knowledge Base），旨在解决现有数据缺乏系统组织、无法实现深入对象理解的问题。该框架通过专家设计和大规模模型应用，将多模态对象知识（包括文本、图像源知识和区域标注）结构化为图。通过构建AnimalKB（包含406个动物类别、22K文本三元组和420K图像），实验证明该知识库能有效提升零样本识别和细粒度VQA等对象级视觉任务的性能，并可作为知识图谱补全和部件分割的挑战性基准。
AI.keywords: 视觉知识库, 对象理解, 多模态知识, 知识图谱, VisKnow
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于系统地组织了多样化的多模态数据（文本事实、视觉属性、部件标注），并将其构建成统一的、基于图的视觉知识库，从而超越了简单的对象分类。这解决了现有数据集中存在的任务导向性强、缺乏系统组织的关键限制。通过构建大规模的AnimalKB，该研究提供了一种整合专家知识和大型模型的实用方法，为需要明确知识组织的高级任务（如推理和VQA）奠定了基础。

title: SOP^2: Transfer Learning with Scene-Oriented Prompt Pool on 3D Object Detection
summary: With the rise of Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT-3, these models exhibit strong generalization capabilities. Through transfer learning techniques such as fine-tuning and prompt tuning, they can be adapted to various downstream tasks with minimal parameter adjustments. This approach is particularly common in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP). This paper aims to explore the effectiveness of common prompt tuning methods in 3D object detection. We investigate whether a model trained on the large-scale Waymo dataset can serve as a foundation model and adapt to other scenarios within the 3D object detection field. This paper sequentially examines the impact of prompt tokens and prompt generators, and further proposes a Scene-Oriented Prompt Pool (\textbf{SOP$^2$}). We demonstrate the effectiveness of prompt pools in 3D object detection, with the goal of inspiring future researchers to delve deeper into the potential of prompts in the 3D field.

AI.title_translation: SOP^2：基于场景导向提示池的3D目标检测迁移学习
AI.tldr: 本文将NLP中的提示调优引入3D目标检测，研究基础模型在不同场景间的迁移。核心贡献是提出了场景导向提示池（SOP^2），并证明了其在3D检测中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 探索在自然语言处理（NLP）中常见的提示调优方法在3D目标检测领域的有效性。具体研究在一个大规模Waymo数据集上训练的模型是否可以作为基础模型，并适应3D目标检测领域的其他场景。
AI.method: 顺序检查提示标记（prompt tokens）和提示生成器（prompt generators）的影响。在此基础上，提出并验证了场景导向提示池（Scene-Oriented Prompt Pool, SOP^2）。
AI.result: 证明了所提出的提示池（prompt pools）在3D目标检测任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 摘要中未提及。 (文章表明目标是启发未来的研究人员深入挖掘提示在3D领域中的潜力，但未给出实验的具体结论。)
AI.translation: 随着GPT-3等大型语言模型（LLMs）的兴起，这些模型展现出强大的泛化能力。通过微调和提示调优等迁移学习技术，它们可以适应各种下游任务，且只需进行最小的参数调整。这种方法在自然语言处理（NLP）领域尤为常见。本文旨在探索常见的提示调优方法在3D目标检测中的有效性。我们研究了在一个大规模Waymo数据集上训练的模型是否可以作为基础模型，并适应3D目标检测领域的其他场景。本文依次考察了提示标记和提示生成器的影响，并进一步提出了一个场景导向提示池（SOP^2）。我们证明了提示池在3D目标检测中的有效性，旨在启发未来的研究人员深入挖掘提示在3D领域中的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了借鉴大型语言模型（LLMs）的提示调优（Prompt Tuning）技术在3D目标检测领域的应用潜力。研究人员旨在将一个在Waymo等大型数据集上训练的基础模型，通过最小的参数调整，迁移适应到新的3D场景。为此，文章系统地分析了提示标记和提示生成器的作用，并创新性地提出了场景导向提示池（SOP^2），证明了该提示池方法在3D目标检测任务中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 3D Object Detection, Prompt Tuning, Transfer Learning, Scene-Oriented Prompt Pool (SOP^2), Foundation Model
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将主要应用于自然语言处理（NLP）的提示调优（Prompt Tuning）和迁移学习范式引入到3D目标检测这一新兴且重要领域。通过提出SOP^2（场景导向提示池），作者试图解决3D目标检测场景迁移中的泛化问题，并证明了这种轻量级调整（最小参数调整）方法在复杂的视觉任务中的潜力。该研究为未来在3D领域构建和使用基础模型提供了新的思路和工具，特别是如何高效地将大规模训练的知识迁移到特定新场景。

title: New VVC profiles targeting Feature Coding for Machines
comments: Accepted for presentation at ICIP 2025 workshop on Coding for Machines
summary: Modern video codecs have been extensively optimized to preserve perceptual quality, leveraging models of the human visual system. However, in split inference systems-where intermediate features from neural network are transmitted instead of pixel data-these assumptions no longer apply. Intermediate features are abstract, sparse, and task-specific, making perceptual fidelity irrelevant. In this paper, we investigate the use of Versatile Video Coding (VVC) for compressing such features under the MPEG-AI Feature Coding for Machines (FCM) standard. We perform a tool-level analysis to understand the impact of individual coding components on compression efficiency and downstream vision task accuracy. Based on these insights, we propose three lightweight essential VVC profiles-Fast, Faster, and Fastest. The Fast profile provides 2.96% BD-Rate gain while reducing encoding time by 21.8%. Faster achieves a 1.85% BD-Rate gain with a 51.5% speedup. Fastest reduces encoding time by 95.6% with only a 1.71% loss in BD-Rate.
comment: Accepted for presentation at ICIP 2025 workshop on Coding for Machines

AI.title_translation: 针对机器特征编码的新VVC配置文件
AI.tldr: 针对机器特征编码（FCM），本文提出基于VVC的三个轻量级配置文件（Fast, Faster, Fastest），通过工具级分析优化编码组件，显著提高了编码速度和BD-Rate效率，特别适合分离推理系统。
AI.motivation: 现代视频编码器针对人类视觉感知优化，但在传输神经网络中间特征（而非像素数据）的分离推理系统中，这些假设不再适用。中间特征是抽象、稀疏且任务特定的，使得传统的感知保真度变得不相关。
AI.method: 研究了在MPEG-AI FCM标准下使用VVC压缩神经网络特征的方法。进行了工具级别的分析，以了解VVC的各个编码组件对压缩效率和下游视觉任务准确性的影响。基于这些见解，提出了三种轻量级VVC配置文件（Fast, Faster, Fastest）。
AI.result: 提出了Fast、Faster和Fastest三种配置文件。Fast：提供2.96%的BD-Rate增益，编码时间减少21.8%。Faster：实现1.85%的BD-Rate增益，速度提升51.5%。Fastest：编码时间减少95.6%，BD-Rate损失仅1.71%。
AI.conclusion: 通过对VVC进行工具级分析和优化，成功为机器特征编码（FCM）设计了三种高效且轻量级的VVC配置文件，实现了压缩效率和编码速度的显著提升。
AI.translation: 现代视频编解码器经过了广泛优化，以利用人类视觉系统模型来保持感知质量。然而，在分离推理系统（即传输神经网络的中间特征而非像素数据）中，这些假设不再适用。中间特征是抽象的、稀疏的且特定于任务，使得感知保真度变得不相关。在本文中，我们研究了在MPEG-AI机器特征编码（FCM）标准下使用通用视频编码（VVC）来压缩此类特征。我们进行了工具级别的分析，以了解各个编码组件对压缩效率和下游视觉任务准确性的影响。基于这些见解，我们提出了三种轻量级基本VVC配置文件——Fast、Faster和Fastest。Fast配置文件提供了2.96%的BD-Rate增益，同时减少了21.8%的编码时间。Faster实现了1.85%的BD-Rate增益，并加快了51.5%的速度。Fastest将编码时间减少了95.6%，而BD-Rate损失仅为1.71%。
AI.summary: 鉴于现有视频编码器不适用于神经网络分离推理系统中的特征传输，本文研究了使用VVC压缩MPEG-AI FCM标准下的中间特征。通过对VVC进行工具级分析，确定了影响压缩效率和下游任务准确性的关键组件。在此基础上，作者提出了Fast、Faster和Fastest三种轻量级VVC配置文件，旨在提高编码速度和压缩效率。实验结果表明，这些新配置文件在保持或提升BD-Rate效率的同时，显著减少了编码时间。
AI.keywords: VVC, 特征编码, 机器视觉, 分离推理, MPEG-AI FCM
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将先进的视频编码标准VVC应用于机器视觉的特征编码，而非传统的基于像素的视频编码。通过工具级分析来定制配置文件，体现了对“机器编码”需求的深刻理解，即关注效率和任务准确性而非感知质量。提出的配置文件在速度和效率上取得了显著平衡，对推动MPEG-AI FCM标准的实际应用具有重要意义。

title: MM-CoT:A Benchmark for Probing Visual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Multimodal Models
summary: The ability to perform Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning marks a major milestone for multimodal models (MMs), enabling them to solve complex visual reasoning problems. Yet a critical question remains: is such reasoning genuinely grounded in visual evidence and logically coherent? Existing benchmarks emphasize generation but neglect verification, i.e., the capacity to assess whether a reasoning chain is both visually consistent and logically valid. To fill this gap, we introduce MM-CoT, a diagnostic benchmark specifically designed to probe the visual grounding and logical coherence of CoT reasoning in MMs. Instead of generating free-form explanations, models must select the sole event chain that satisfies two orthogonal constraints: (i) visual consistency, ensuring all steps are anchored in observable evidence, and (ii) logical coherence, ensuring causal and commonsense validity. Adversarial distractors are engineered to violate one of these constraints, exposing distinct reasoning failures. We evaluate leading vision-language models on MM-CoT and find that even the most advanced systems struggle, revealing a sharp discrepancy between generative fluency and true reasoning fidelity. MM-CoT shows low correlation with existing benchmarks, confirming that it measures a unique combination of visual grounding and logical reasoning. This benchmark provides a foundation for developing future models that reason not just plausibly, but faithfully and coherently within the visual world.

AI.title_translation: MM-CoT：一个用于探究多模态模型中视觉思维链推理的基准
AI.tldr: 我们创建了MM-CoT，这是一个新的基准，用于测试多模态模型的思维链推理是否真正基于视觉证据和逻辑。当前先进的模型未能通过这项验证测试，表明它们生成流畅但推理忠实度不足。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态模型虽然能进行思维链（CoT）推理，但缺乏对推理过程是否真正基于视觉证据且具有逻辑连贯性的验证。现有基准侧重于生成，而忽略了验证能力，从而未能诊断出视觉基础和逻辑连贯性方面的缺陷。
AI.method: 引入诊断性基准MM-CoT。模型必须从选项中选择唯一满足视觉一致性（基于可观察证据）和逻辑连贯性（因果和常识有效性）的事件链，而不是生成自由形式的解释。基准中设计了对抗性干扰项来暴露特定的推理失败。
AI.result: 评估了领先的视觉-语言模型，发现即使是最先进的系统也面临困难，揭示了生成流畅性与真实推理忠实度之间的巨大差异。MM-CoT与现有基准相关性低，证实了它测量的是视觉基础和逻辑推理的独特组合。
AI.conclusion: MM-CoT为开发未来能够忠实、连贯地在视觉世界中进行推理的模型奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 执行思维链（CoT）推理的能力标志着多模态模型（MMs）的一个重要里程碑，使其能够解决复杂的视觉推理问题。然而，一个关键问题仍然存在：这种推理是否真正基于视觉证据且具有逻辑连贯性？现有基准侧重于生成，但忽略了验证能力，即评估推理链是否同时具有视觉一致性和逻辑有效性的能力。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了MM-CoT，这是一个专门设计用于探究多模态模型中CoT推理的视觉基础和逻辑连贯性的诊断性基准。模型不是生成自由形式的解释，而是必须选择唯一满足两个正交约束的事件链：(i) 视觉一致性，确保所有步骤都锚定在可观察的证据中；(ii) 逻辑连贯性，确保因果和常识的有效性。我们设计了对抗性干扰项，使其违反其中一个约束，从而暴露出不同的推理失败。我们评估了领先的视觉-语言模型在MM-CoT上的表现，发现即使是最先进的系统也面临困难，揭示了生成流畅性与真实推理忠实度之间的巨大差异。MM-CoT与现有基准显示出低相关性，证实它测量的是视觉基础和逻辑推理的独特组合。该基准为未来开发不仅合理、而且能在视觉世界中忠实且连贯地进行推理的模型奠定了基础。
AI.summary: MM-CoT是一个新的诊断性基准，旨在解决现有基准忽视多模态模型思维链推理的视觉基础和逻辑连贯性验证的问题。该基准要求模型从选项中选择唯一满足视觉一致性（基于可观察证据）和逻辑连贯性（因果和常识有效性）的事件链。评估结果显示，先进的模型在MM-CoT上表现不佳，表明其生成能力与真实推理能力之间存在显著差距。MM-CoT为未来开发更可靠的推理模型提供了工具。
AI.keywords: MM-CoT, 视觉推理, 思维链, 多模态模型, 视觉基础
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将重点从生成合理的CoT解释转移到验证推理的忠实度和基础性。通过强制模型选择同时满足视觉一致性（基于可观察证据）和逻辑连贯性（因果和常识有效性）的事件链，并使用对抗性干扰项，MM-CoT有效地诊断了特定的失败模式（视觉或逻辑）。这揭示了当前多模态模型的一个主要局限性：生成流畅性不等于推理忠实度，暗示了许多现有的CoT成功可能依赖于语言先验而不是真正的跨模态理解。该基准对推动未来多模态模型的发展至关重要。

title: Geometry-Aware Sparse Depth Sampling for High-Fidelity RGB-D Depth Completion in Robotic Systems
summary: Accurate three-dimensional perception is essential for modern industrial robotic systems that perform manipulation, inspection, and navigation tasks. RGB-D and stereo vision sensors are widely used for this purpose, but the depth maps they produce are often noisy, incomplete, or biased due to sensor limitations and environmental conditions. Depth completion methods aim to generate dense, reliable depth maps from RGB images and sparse depth input. However, a key limitation in current depth completion pipelines is the unrealistic generation of sparse depth: sparse pixels are typically selected uniformly at random from dense ground-truth depth, ignoring the fact that real sensors exhibit geometry-dependent and spatially nonuniform reliability. In this work, we propose a normal-guided sparse depth sampling strategy that leverages PCA-based surface normal estimation on the RGB-D point cloud to compute a per-pixel depth reliability measure. The sparse depth samples are then drawn according to this reliability distribution. We integrate this sampling method with the Marigold-DC diffusion-based depth completion model and evaluate it on NYU Depth v2 using the standard metrics. Experiments show that our geometry-aware sparse depth improves accuracy, reduces artifacts near edges and discontinuities, and produces more realistic training conditions that better reflect real sensor behavior.

AI.title_translation: 机器人系统中用于高保真 RGB-D 深度补全的几何感知稀疏深度采样
AI.tldr: 针对现有深度补全训练中稀疏深度生成不真实的问题，本文提出了一种基于法线引导的几何感知稀疏深度采样策略，以更好地模拟真实传感器特性，从而提高了深度补全的准确性并减少了伪影。
AI.motivation: 准确的三维感知对现代工业机器人系统至关重要。然而，RGB-D 传感器生成的深度图通常是嘈杂、不完整或有偏差的。当前深度补全流程的一个关键限制是稀疏深度的生成方式不切实际，通常是随机均匀采样，忽略了真实传感器可靠性依赖于几何形状且空间非均匀的特性。
AI.method: 提出了一种法线引导的稀疏深度采样策略。该方法利用基于主成分分析（PCA）的表面法线估计，在 RGB-D 点云上计算逐像素的深度可靠性度量。然后，根据这种可靠性分布来抽取稀疏深度样本。该采样方法被集成并评估于 Marigold-DC 扩散型深度补全模型上。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提出的几何感知稀疏深度采样策略提高了深度补全的准确性，减少了边缘和不连续性附近的伪影，并产生了更能反映真实传感器行为的训练条件。
AI.translation: 准确的三维感知对于执行操纵、检查和导航任务的现代工业机器人系统至关重要。RGB-D 和立体视觉传感器广泛用于此目的，但由于传感器限制和环境条件，它们生成的深度图通常是嘈杂、不完整或有偏差的。深度补全方法旨在从 RGB 图像和稀疏深度输入中生成密集、可靠的深度图。然而，当前深度补全流程中的一个关键限制是稀疏深度的生成不切实际：稀疏像素通常是从密集的真实深度中随机均匀选择的，忽略了真实传感器表现出依赖于几何形状且空间非均匀的可靠性这一事实。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种法线引导的稀疏深度采样策略，该策略利用基于 PCA 的表面法线估计在 RGB-D 点云上计算逐像素的深度可靠性度量。然后，根据这种可靠性分布抽取稀疏深度样本。我们将此采样方法与 Marigold-DC 扩散型深度补全模型相结合，并使用标准指标在 NYU Depth v2 上进行评估。实验表明，我们的几何感知稀疏深度提高了准确性，减少了边缘和不连续性附近的伪影，并产生了更能反映真实传感器行为的训练条件。
AI.summary: 本文解决了深度补全训练中稀疏深度生成不真实的问题，指出现有方法通常随机均匀采样，未能反映真实传感器可靠性依赖于物体几何形状的特性。为此，作者提出了一种“法线引导的稀疏深度采样策略”，该策略通过在 RGB-D 点云上进行基于 PCA 的表面法线估计来计算逐像素的深度可靠性。根据这种可靠性分布进行采样，可以为深度补全模型提供更真实的训练输入。实验证明，该方法能提高深度补全精度，减少边缘伪影。
AI.keywords: 几何感知, 稀疏深度采样, 深度补全, RGB-D, 机器人系统
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于认识到现有深度补全模型训练中稀疏深度输入的生成方式与真实传感器行为存在脱节。通过引入“几何感知”的采样策略（基于表面法线估计的可靠性），作者有效地弥合了训练环境和实际部署环境之间的差距。这种方法不仅提高了模型的性能指标（准确性），更重要的是，它通过模拟真实世界传感器在几何复杂区域的可靠性下降，使得训练条件更加逼真，这对于提高机器人系统在复杂环境中的鲁棒性至关重要。

title: Empowerment Gain and Causal Model Construction: Children and adults are sensitive to controllability and variability in their causal interventions
comments: Accepted to Philosophical Transactions A, Special issue: World models, AGI, and the hard problems of life-mind continuity. Expected publication in 2026
summary: Learning about the causal structure of the world is a fundamental problem for human cognition. Causal models and especially causal learning have proved to be difficult for large pretrained models using standard techniques of deep learning. In contrast, cognitive scientists have applied advances in our formal understanding of causation in computer science, particularly within the Causal Bayes Net formalism, to understand human causal learning. In the very different tradition of reinforcement learning, researchers have described an intrinsic reward signal called "empowerment" which maximizes mutual information between actions and their outcomes. "Empowerment" may be an important bridge between classical Bayesian causal learning and reinforcement learning and may help to characterize causal learning in humans and enable it in machines. If an agent learns an accurate causal world model, they will necessarily increase their empowerment, and increasing empowerment will lead to a more accurate causal world model. Empowerment may also explain distinctive features of childrens causal learning, as well as providing a more tractable computational account of how that learning is possible. In an empirical study, we systematically test how children and adults use cues to empowerment to infer causal relations, and design effective causal interventions.
