AI.summary: 本文提出了以影响为导向的AI框架（IDAIF），这是一种将变革理论（ToC）的结构化社会影响模型与AI系统架构相结合的新方法。IDAIF通过将ToC的五阶段（输入到影响）映射到AI的五个架构层（数据层到规范层），系统地解决了AI的价值对齐和社会技术维度问题。该框架在每一层都使用了先进技术（如帕累托优化、因果DAGs和RLHF），并包含一个保障层来处理失败。IDAIF旨在将AI开发范式从单纯追求技术准确性转向追求可衡量的社会影响和伦理效益。
AI.keywords: 影响驱动AI, 变革理论, AI对齐, 社会技术系统, 架构框架
AI.comments: IDAIF的创新点在于其系统地整合了“变革理论”（Theory of Change, ToC）——这是一个源自社会科学和公共政策的框架——与AI系统工程架构。这为解决AI对齐问题提供了一个比传统上只关注技术指标（如准确性）更全面的社会技术视角。随着AI部署到高风险领域，确保其行为符合人类价值观和预期影响变得至关重要。IDAIF提供了一个具体的、分层的架构蓝图，将抽象的伦理目标转化为可操作的工程组件（如使用帕累托优化进行价值对齐，使用因果DAGs缓解幻觉），这对于推动可信赖AI的实践落地具有重要指导意义。该框架代表了从以模型为中心到以影响为中心的AI开发的范式转变，具有高度的实践价值。

title: Connectivity-Preserving Cortical Surface Tetrahedralization
summary: A prerequisite for many biomechanical simulation techniques is discretizing a bounded volume into a tetrahedral mesh. In certain contexts, such as cortical surface simulations, preserving input surface connectivity is critical. However, automated surface extraction often yields meshes containing self-intersections, small holes, and faulty geometry, which prevents existing constrained and unconstrained meshers from preserving this connectivity. We address this issue by developing a novel tetrahedralization method that maintains input surface connectivity in the presence of such defects. We also present a metric to quantify the preservation of surface connectivity and demonstrate that our method correctly maintains connectivity compared to existing solutions.

AI.title_translation: 保持连通性的皮层表面四面体化
AI.tldr: 针对皮层表面模拟中网格缺陷导致连通性丢失的问题，本文提出了一种新的四面体化方法，即使在存在自相交和小孔的情况下也能保持表面连通性，并优于现有方案。
AI.motivation: 许多生物力学模拟（如皮层表面模拟）需要将有界体积离散化为四面体网格，且保持输入表面连通性至关重要。然而，自动表面提取产生的网格通常存在自相交和几何缺陷，导致现有网格划分器无法保持连通性。
AI.method: 开发了一种新颖的四面体化方法，该方法能够在存在自相交、小孔和错误几何形状等缺陷的情况下保持输入表面连通性。同时提出了一种量化表面连通性保持程度的度量标准。
AI.result: 该方法与现有解决方案相比，能够正确地保持连通性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功地解决了在存在几何缺陷的情况下保持皮层表面连通性的问题，并被证明优于现有解决方案。
AI.translation: 许多生物力学模拟技术的前提是将有界体积离散化为四面体网格。在某些背景下，例如皮层表面模拟，保持输入表面连通性至关重要。然而，自动表面提取通常会产生包含自相交、小孔和错误几何形状的网格，这使得现有的受约束和非受约束网格划分器无法保持这种连通性。我们通过开发一种新颖的四面体化方法来解决这个问题，该方法在存在此类缺陷的情况下仍能保持输入表面连通性。我们还提出了一种量化表面连通性保持程度的度量标准，并证明我们的方法与现有解决方案相比能正确保持连通性。
AI.summary: 生物力学模拟（尤其是皮层表面模拟）要求在将体积离散化为四面体网格时必须保持表面连通性。针对自动表面提取产生的网格缺陷（如自相交、小孔）导致现有方法失效的问题，本文提出了一种新颖的四面体化方法，专门用于在存在此类缺陷时保持输入表面连通性。此外，本文还引入了一个量化连通性保持的度量标准，并证明该方法在保持连通性方面优于现有解决方案。
AI.keywords: 连通性保持, 皮层表面, 四面体化, 生物力学模拟, 网格缺陷
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于解决了一个实际的、由数据采集缺陷引发的问题：如何对包含自相交、小孔和错误几何形状的皮层表面进行四面体化，同时保证其拓扑连通性。这对于依赖精确几何和拓扑信息的生物力学模拟至关重要。该方法直接处理了现有网格划分器因几何缺陷而失效的关键痛点，并且引入了量化连通性保持的度量标准，增强了方法的验证性和实用性。

title: Biothreat Benchmark Generation Framework for Evaluating Frontier AI Models II: Benchmark Generation Process
summary: The potential for rapidly-evolving frontier artificial intelligence (AI) models, especially large language models (LLMs), to facilitate bioterrorism or access to biological weapons has generated significant policy, academic, and public concern. Both model developers and policymakers seek to quantify and mitigate any risk, with an important element of such efforts being the development of model benchmarks that can assess the biosecurity risk posed by a particular model. This paper, the second in a series of three, describes the second component of a novel Biothreat Benchmark Generation (BBG) framework: the generation of the Bacterial Biothreat Benchmark (B3) dataset. The development process involved three complementary approaches: 1) web-based prompt generation, 2) red teaming, and 3) mining existing benchmark corpora, to generate over 7,000 potential benchmarks linked to the Task-Query Architecture that was developed during the first component of the project. A process of de-duplication, followed by an assessment of uplift diagnosticity, and general quality control measures, reduced the candidates to a set of 1,010 final benchmarks. This procedure ensured that these benchmarks are a) diagnostic in terms of providing uplift; b) directly relevant to biosecurity threats; and c) are aligned with a larger biosecurity architecture permitting nuanced analysis at different levels of analysis.

AI.title_translation: 生物威胁基准生成框架，用于评估前沿人工智能模型II：基准生成过程
AI.tldr: 该论文描述了生物威胁基准生成（BBG）框架的第二部分，即细菌生物威胁基准（B3）数据集的生成。通过网络提示生成、红队演练和现有基准语料库挖掘三种方法，生成了超过7000个潜在基准。经过去重、诊断提升评估和质量控制，最终筛选出1010个基准，确保其诊断性、与生物安全威胁的相关性以及与更大数据结构的对齐。
AI.motivation: 随着前沿人工智能模型（尤其是大型语言模型）的快速发展，它们可能被用于生物恐怖主义或获取生物武器的风险引起了广泛关注。模型开发者和政策制定者需要量化和减轻这种风险，而开发能够评估模型生物安全风险的模型基准是其中的关键环节。
AI.method: 该研究采用了三种互补的方法来生成细菌生物威胁基准（B3）数据集：1）基于网络的提示生成；2）红队演练；3）挖掘现有的基准语料库。随后，通过去重、诊断提升评估和质量控制等步骤，对生成的候选基准进行了筛选。
AI.result: 通过结合三种生成方法，最初生成了超过7000个潜在的细菌生物威胁基准。经过一系列的筛选和评估过程，最终确定了1010个高质量的基准。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功开发并生成了一个包含1010个高质量细菌生物威胁基准的数据集（B3），该数据集具有诊断性、与生物安全威胁高度相关，并能与现有的生物安全架构兼容，为评估和缓解AI模型带来的生物安全风险提供了有力工具。
AI.translation: 随着前沿人工智能（AI）模型，特别是大型语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，它们可能被用于生物恐怖主义或获取生物武器的可能性，已引起政策、学术界和公众的广泛担忧。模型开发者和政策制定者都寻求量化和减轻任何风险，而此类努力的一个重要组成部分是开发能够评估特定模型所带来的生物安全风险的模型基准。本篇论文是三部曲中的第二篇，描述了一个新颖的生物威胁基准生成（BBG）框架的第二组成部分：细菌生物威胁基准（B3）数据集的生成。开发过程涉及三种互补的方法：1）基于网络的提示生成，2）红队演练，以及3）挖掘现有的基准语料库，生成了超过7000个与在项目第一部分开发的任务-查询架构相关联的潜在基准。通过去重、评估提升诊断性以及一般的质量控制措施，将候选基准减少到最终的1010个基准。该程序确保了这些基准具有a）在提供提升方面的诊断性；b）与生物安全威胁直接相关；以及c）与一个允许在不同分析层面进行细致分析的更大的生物安全架构相一致。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了生物威胁基准生成（BBG）框架的第二部分，重点介绍了细菌生物威胁基准（B3）数据集的生成过程。通过结合网络提示生成、红队演练和现有数据挖掘，研究人员创建了一个包含超过7000个潜在基准的初始集合。经过严格的去重、诊断提升评估和质量控制，最终生成了1010个高质量的基准，这些基准在诊断性、与生物安全威胁的相关性以及与整体生物安全架构的兼容性方面均表现优异。
AI.keywords: 生物威胁基准, 人工智能模型评估, 大型语言模型, 生物安全风险, 数据集生成
AI.comments: 该研究在评估前沿AI模型生物安全风险方面取得了重要进展，通过系统化的方法生成了高质量的基准数据集。然而，红队演练和质量控制的具体细节可以进一步阐述，以增强研究的可复现性和透明度。此外，未来研究可以探索如何将这些基准应用于不同类型的AI模型，并评估其在实际生物安全防御中的有效性。

title: MPC for tracking for anesthesia dynamics
summary: In this paper, an MPC for tracking formulation is proposed for the control of anesthesia dynamics. It seamlessly enables the optimization of the steady-states pair that is not unique due to the MISO nature of the model. Anesthesia dynamics is a multi-time scale system with two types of states characterized, respectively, by fast and slow dynamics. In anesthesia control, the output equation depends only on the fast dynamics. Therefore, the slow states can be treated as disturbances, and compensation terms can be introduced. Subsequently, the system can be reformulated as a nominal one allowing the design of an MPC for tracking strategy. The presented framework ensures recursive feasibility and asymptotic stability, through the design of appropriate terminal ingredients in the MPC for tracking framework. The controller performance is then assessed on a patient in a simulation environment.

AI.title_translation: 用于麻醉动力学跟踪的 MPC
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种用于麻醉动力学控制的 MPC（模型预测控制）跟踪方法。它解决了由于 MISO（多输入单输出）模型的固有特性而导致的稳态点不唯一的问题。通过将麻醉动力学系统（具有快慢两种动力学状态）中的慢状态视为干扰并引入补偿项，可以将系统重构为标称系统，从而设计 MPC 跟踪策略。该框架通过设计合适的终端条件，保证了递归可行性和渐近稳定性。最后，在仿真环境中对控制器在患者身上的性能进行了评估。
AI.motivation: 麻醉动力学是一个多时间尺度系统，其输出方程仅依赖于快动态。慢状态可以被视为干扰，因此需要一种能够处理这种不确定性并优化稳态点（由于 MISO 模型而可能不唯一）的控制方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种用于麻醉动力学跟踪的 MPC（模型预测控制）方法。该方法通过将慢状态视为干扰并引入补偿项，将系统重构为标称系统，从而允许设计 MPC 跟踪策略。通过设计合适的终端成分，保证了递归可行性和渐近稳定性。
AI.result: 在仿真环境中，对控制器在患者身上的性能进行了评估，证明了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的 MPC 跟踪框架能够有效地控制麻醉动力学，通过处理慢状态和优化不唯一的稳态点，保证了系统的递归可行性和渐近稳定性。
AI.translation: 在本文中，提出了一种用于麻醉动力学控制的 MPC（模型预测控制）跟踪方法。它无缝地实现了稳态点对的优化，由于模型的 MISO（多输入单输出）性质，该稳态点对不是唯一的。麻醉动力学是一个多时间尺度系统，具有两种类型的状态，分别由快和慢的动力学特征决定。在麻醉控制中，输出方程仅依赖于快动力学。因此，慢状态可以被视为干扰，并且可以引入补偿项。随后，可以将系统重构为一个标称系统，从而设计一种 MPC 跟踪策略。通过设计合适的终端成分，所提出的框架确保了递归可行性和渐近稳定性。最后，在仿真环境中对控制器在患者身上的性能进行了评估。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的 MPC（模型预测控制）跟踪方法，用于控制具有快慢两种动力学特性的麻醉系统。该方法通过将慢状态视为干扰并引入补偿项，有效处理了 MISO 模型导致的稳态点不唯一问题，并将系统重构为标称形式。通过设计合适的终端成分，该方法保证了控制器的递归可行性和渐近稳定性。最后，在仿真环境中对该控制器在患者身上的性能进行了评估。
AI.keywords: 模型预测控制, 麻醉动力学, MISO系统, 慢状态干扰, 递归可行性, 渐近稳定性
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地利用了麻醉动力学系统的多时间尺度特性，将慢状态视为可控的干扰，从而简化了控制问题。MPC 跟踪方法的应用以及对递归可行性和渐近稳定性的保证是该研究的亮点。然而，仅在仿真环境中评估控制器性能可能限制了其在真实临床应用中的直接可信度，未来的工作可以考虑进行临床试验。

title: Biothreat Benchmark Generation Framework for Evaluating Frontier AI Models III: Implementing the Bacterial Biothreat Benchmark (B3) Dataset
summary: The potential for rapidly-evolving frontier artificial intelligence (AI) models, especially large language models (LLMs), to facilitate bioterrorism or access to biological weapons has generated significant policy, academic, and public concern. Both model developers and policymakers seek to quantify and mitigate any risk, with an important element of such efforts being the development of model benchmarks that can assess the biosecurity risk posed by a particular model. This paper discusses the pilot implementation of the Bacterial Biothreat Benchmark (B3) dataset. It is the third in a series of three papers describing an overall Biothreat Benchmark Generation (BBG) framework, with previous papers detailing the development of the B3 dataset. The pilot involved running the benchmarks through a sample frontier AI model, followed by human evaluation of model responses, and an applied risk analysis of the results along several dimensions. Overall, the pilot demonstrated that the B3 dataset offers a viable, nuanced method for rapidly assessing the biosecurity risk posed by a LLM, identifying the key sources of that risk and providing guidance for priority areas of mitigation priority.

AI.title_translation: 生物威胁基准生成框架，用于评估前沿人工智能模型 III：细菌生物威胁基准 (B3) 数据集的实现
AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了细菌生物威胁基准 (B3) 数据集的试点实施，该数据集旨在评估前沿人工智能模型（特别是大型语言模型）在生物安全方面的风险。
AI.motivation: 人工智能模型（尤其是大型语言模型）可能被用于协助生物恐怖主义或获取生物武器，引发了政策制定者、学术界和公众的担忧。因此，需要开发模型基准来量化和减轻这种风险。
AI.method: 通过对一个样本前沿人工智能模型运行 B3 基准测试，然后进行人工评估模型响应，并对结果进行多维度应用风险分析。
AI.result: B3 数据集提供了一种可行且细致的方法，可以快速评估大型语言模型的生物安全风险，识别风险的关键来源，并为缓解措施的优先领域提供指导。
AI.conclusion: B3 数据集在试点评估中被证明是评估大型语言模型生物安全风险的有效工具，能够识别风险来源并指导缓解策略。
AI.translation: 人工智能模型（尤其是大型语言模型）的快速发展，可能被用于协助生物恐怖主义或获取生物武器，这引起了政策、学术和公众的极大担忧。模型开发者和政策制定者都希望量化和减轻任何风险，而此类努力的一个重要组成部分是开发能够评估特定模型所带来的生物安全风险的模型基准。本文讨论了细菌生物威胁基准 (B3) 数据集的试点实施。这是描述总体生物威胁基准生成 (BBG) 框架的三篇系列论文中的第三篇，前两篇论文详细介绍了 B3 数据集的开发。试点工作包括将基准测试运行在一个样本前沿人工智能模型上，然后由人工评估模型响应，并对结果进行多维度应用风险分析。总的来说，试点工作表明 B3 数据集提供了一种可行且细致的方法，可以快速评估大型语言模型所带来的生物安全风险，识别该风险的关键来源，并为缓解措施的优先领域提供指导。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了细菌生物威胁基准 (B3) 数据集的试点实施情况，该数据集是生物威胁基准生成 (BBG) 框架的一部分。通过对一个前沿人工智能模型进行基准测试和人工评估，研究表明 B3 数据集能够有效、细致地评估大型语言模型的生物安全风险，并为风险缓解提供指导。
AI.keywords: 生物威胁, 人工智能模型, 大型语言模型, 生物安全风险, B3 数据集
AI.comments: 该研究在评估前沿 AI 模型（特别是 LLM）的生物安全风险方面取得了重要进展。B3 数据集及其试点评估为量化和减轻与生物威胁相关的风险提供了一个有价值的工具。然而，对“关键风险来源”和“缓解措施的优先领域”的具体细节的进一步阐述将增强其影响力。此外，探索该基准在不同类型 AI 模型和不断变化的生物威胁格局中的适应性将是未来研究的一个有益方向。

title: Measuring Agile Agreement: Development and Validation of the Manifesto and Principle Scales
summary:
While the importance of human factors in agile software development is widely acknowledged, the measurement of an individual's "agile agreement" remains an ill-defined and challenging area. A key limitation in existing research is the failure to distinguish between agreement with the abstract, high-level values of the Agile Manifesto and agreement with the concrete, day-to-day practices derived from the 12 Principles. This paper addresses this methodological gap by presenting the design and validation of two distinct instruments: the novel Manifesto Agreement Scale (MAS), and the Principle Agreement Scale (PAS), which is a systematic adaptation and refinement of a prior instrument.
  We detail the systematic process of item creation and selection, survey design, and validation. The results demonstrate that both scales possess important internal consistency and construct validity. A convergence and divergence analysis, including Proportional Odds Logistic Regression, a Bland-Altman plot, and an Intraclass Correlation Coefficient (ICC), reveals that while the two scales are moderately correlated, they are not interchangeable and capture distinct dimensions of agile agreement. The primary contribution of this work is a pair of publicly available instruments, validated within a specific demographic of Belgian IT professionals. These scales represent a critical initial step toward facilitating a more nuanced measurement of agile agreement, distinguishing agile agreement across various levels of perception and aiding in a more refined interpretation of person-agile fit.

AI.title_translation: 衡量敏捷认同：宣言和原则量表的开发与验证
AI.tldr: 研究人员创建并验证了两个量表——MAS和PAS，用于区分人们对敏捷宣言（价值观）和敏捷原则（实践）的认同程度，发现它们测量的是不同的方面，为更精细地研究敏捷契合度提供了工具。
AI.motivation: 敏捷软件开发中人为因素的重要性已被广泛认可，但个体“敏捷认同”的测量仍然是一个定义模糊且具有挑战性的领域。现有研究的一个关键局限是未能区分对抽象、高层敏捷宣言的认同与对源自12项原则的具体、日常实践的认同。
AI.method: 设计并验证了两个独立的量表：新颖的宣言认同量表（MAS）和原则认同量表（PAS）（对先前工具的系统性调整和完善）。详细介绍了条目创建和选择、问卷设计和验证的系统过程。使用收敛和发散分析（包括比例优势逻辑回归、Bland-Altman图和组内相关系数（ICC））来评估量表间的关系。
AI.result: 结果表明，MAS和PAS两个量表都具有重要的内部一致性和结构效度。收敛和发散分析显示，这两个量表存在中度相关，但不可互换，且捕获了敏捷认同的不同维度。
AI.conclusion: 本研究的主要贡献是一对公开可用的、在比利时IT专业人士特定人群中得到验证的量表，它们是促进对敏捷认同进行更细致测量的关键第一步，有助于区分不同感知层面的敏捷认同，并辅助更精确地解释人与敏捷的契合度。
AI.translation: 虽然敏捷软件开发中人为因素的重要性得到了广泛认可，但对个体“敏捷认同”的测量仍然是一个定义模糊且具有挑战性的领域。现有研究的一个关键局限是未能区分对抽象、高层敏捷宣言的认同与对源自12项原则的具体、日常实践的认同。本文通过提出和验证两种不同的工具来解决这一方法学上的空白：新颖的宣言认同量表（MAS），以及原则认同量表（PAS），后者是对先前工具的系统性调整和完善。我们详细介绍了条目创建和选择、问卷设计和验证的系统过程。结果表明，这两个量表都具有重要的内部一致性和结构效度。收敛和发散分析，包括比例优势逻辑回归、Bland-Altman图和组内相关系数（ICC），揭示了尽管这两个量表存在中度相关，但它们是不可互换的，并且捕获了敏捷认同的不同维度。这项工作的主要贡献是一对在比利时IT专业人士特定人群中得到验证的、可公开使用的工具。这些量表是促进对敏捷认同进行更细致测量的关键初步步骤，有助于区分不同感知层面的敏捷认同，并辅助对人与敏捷契合度进行更精确的解释。
AI.summary: 本文针对敏捷软件开发中测量个体“敏捷认同”的不足，开发并验证了两个区分性的量表：宣言认同量表（MAS）和原则认同量表（PAS），以解决区分高层价值认同与具体实践认同的方法学空白。通过系统化的设计和验证流程，研究证实了这两个量表的效度和可靠性，并证明它们测量的是不同的敏捷认同维度，为更精确地评估人与敏捷的契合度提供了工具。
AI.keywords: 敏捷软件开发, 敏捷宣言, 敏捷原则, 测量工具, 敏捷认同
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于首次区分了对敏捷宣言（高层价值）和12项原则（具体实践）的认同，并为此开发了两个独立的、经过验证的量表。其重要性在于为敏捷软件开发中“人-敏捷契合度”的测量提供了更细致的工具。局限性可能在于验证样本局限于比利时IT专业人士。

title: Transformers for Multimodal Brain State Decoding: Integrating Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging Data and Medical Metadata
summary: Decoding brain states from functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data is vital for advancing neuroscience and clinical applications. While traditional machine learning and deep learning approaches have made strides in leveraging the high-dimensional and complex nature of fMRI data, they often fail to utilize the contextual richness provided by Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine (DICOM) metadata. This paper presents a novel framework integrating transformer-based architectures with multimodal inputs, including fMRI data and DICOM metadata. By employing attention mechanisms, the proposed method captures intricate spatial-temporal patterns and contextual relationships, enhancing model accuracy, interpretability, and robustness. The potential of this framework spans applications in clinical diagnostics, cognitive neuroscience, and personalized medicine. Limitations, such as metadata variability and computational demands, are addressed, and future directions for optimizing scalability and generalizability are discussed.

AI.title_translation: 用于多模态脑状态解码的Transformer：整合功能磁共振成像数据和医疗元数据
AI.tldr: 使用带有注意力机制的Transformer模型，将fMRI数据与DICOM医疗元数据结合起来解码脑状态，提高了准确性和可解释性，但计算量大且受元数据质量影响。
AI.motivation: 传统的机器学习和深度学习方法在利用高维和复杂的fMRI数据方面取得了进展，但它们通常未能充分利用DICOM元数据提供的丰富上下文信息，而脑状态解码对于神经科学和临床应用至关重要。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的框架，将基于Transformer的架构与fMRI数据和DICOM元数据等多模态输入相结合，并利用注意力机制来捕获复杂的空间-时间模式和上下文关系。
AI.result: 通过集成Transformer和多模态输入（fMRI和DICOM元数据），所提出的方法增强了模型的准确性、可解释性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架的潜力涵盖临床诊断、认知神经科学和个性化医疗等应用。论文讨论了解决元数据变异性和计算需求等局限性，并探讨了优化可扩展性和通用性的未来方向。
AI.translation: 从功能磁共振成像（fMRI）数据解码脑状态对于推进神经科学和临床应用至关重要。虽然传统的机器学习和深度学习方法在利用fMRI数据的高维复杂特性方面取得了进展，但它们往往未能利用数字成像和通信医学（DICOM）元数据提供的丰富上下文信息。本文提出了一种新颖的框架，将基于Transformer的架构与包括fMRI数据和DICOM元数据在内的多模态输入相结合。通过采用注意力机制，所提出的方法捕获了复杂的空间-时间模式和上下文关系，从而提高了模型的准确性、可解释性和鲁棒性。该框架的潜力涵盖了临床诊断、认知神经科学和个性化医疗等应用。论文讨论了元数据变异性和计算需求等局限性，并探讨了优化可扩展性和通用性的未来方向。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于Transformer的多模态框架，用于整合功能磁共振成像（fMRI）数据和医疗元数据（DICOM），以解码脑状态。该方法利用注意力机制来更好地捕获复杂模式和上下文关系，从而提高了解码的准确性和鲁棒性，适用于临床和神经科学应用。
AI.keywords: 脑状态解码, fMRI, DICOM元数据, Transformer, 多模态学习
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于首次将Transformer架构应用于fMRI数据和DICOM医疗元数据的多模态融合，利用注意力机制捕捉复杂的时空模式和上下文关系。其重要性在于提高了脑状态解码的准确性、可解释性和鲁棒性。局限性在于元数据的可变性以及计算需求较高。

title: Using reinforcement learning to probe the role of feedback in skill acquisition
summary: Many high-performance human activities are executed with little or no external feedback: think of a figure skater landing a triple jump, a pitcher throwing a curveball for a strike, or a barista pouring latte art. To study the process of skill acquisition under fully controlled conditions, we bypass human subjects. Instead, we directly interface a generalist reinforcement learning agent with a spinning cylinder in a tabletop circulating water channel to maximize or minimize drag. This setup has several desirable properties. First, it is a physical system, with the rich interactions and complex dynamics that only the physical world has: the flow is highly chaotic and extremely difficult, if not impossible, to model or simulate accurately. Second, the objective -- drag minimization or maximization -- is easy to state and can be captured directly in the reward, yet good strategies are not obvious beforehand. Third, decades-old experimental studies provide recipes for simple, high-performance open-loop policies. Finally, the setup is inexpensive and far easier to reproduce than human studies. In our experiments we find that high-dimensional flow feedback lets the agent discover high-performance drag-control strategies with only minutes of real-world interaction. When we later replay the same action sequences without any feedback, we obtain almost identical performance. This shows that feedback, and in particular flow feedback, is not needed to execute the learned policy. Surprisingly, without flow feedback during training the agent fails to discover any well-performing policy in drag maximization, but still succeeds in drag minimization, albeit more slowly and less reliably. Our studies show that learning a high-performance skill can require richer information than executing it, and learning conditions can be kind or wicked depending solely on the goal, not on dynamics or policy complexity.

AI.title_translation: 使用强化学习探究反馈在技能获取中的作用
AI.tldr: 研究人员使用强化学习智能体与物理系统（在循环水通道中旋转的圆柱体）交互，以控制阻力。他们发现，在有高维流反馈的情况下，智能体可以在几分钟内学会高性能策略，并且在没有反馈的情况下也能很好地执行这些策略。然而，在没有流反馈的情况下进行训练，智能体在最大化阻力方面表现不佳，但在最小化阻力方面仍然可以成功，尽管速度较慢且效果较差。这表明学习高性能技能可能需要比执行技能更丰富的信息，并且学习条件会根据目标而变化。
AI.motivation: 研究在几乎没有外部反馈的情况下，高难度人类活动（如花样滑冰、棒球投掷、拉花艺术）的技能获取过程。作者希望通过一个受控的物理系统来模拟和研究这一过程，以理解反馈在技能学习中的作用。
AI.method: 研究人员使用一个通用的强化学习智能体与一个在循环水通道中旋转的圆柱体进行交互。该智能体的目标是最大化或最小化阻力。他们比较了在有和没有高维流反馈的情况下训练智能体的效果，并评估了在没有反馈的情况下执行所学策略的性能。
AI.result: 在有高维流反馈的情况下，智能体可以在几分钟内学会高性能的阻力控制策略。当在没有反馈的情况下重放相同的动作序列时，性能几乎没有下降。然而，在没有流反馈的情况下进行训练，智能体在最大化阻力方面未能发现有效的策略，但在最小化阻力方面仍然可以成功，尽管学习速度较慢且效果不太可靠。
AI.conclusion: 学习高性能技能可能需要比执行技能更丰富的信息。学习条件（“友好”或“敌对”）可能仅取决于目标，而与动力学或策略的复杂性无关。
AI.translation: 许多高绩效的人类活动几乎在没有外部反馈的情况下执行：想想花样滑冰运动员完成三周跳，投手投出好球的曲球，或者咖啡师冲泡拿铁艺术。为了在完全受控的条件下研究技能获取过程，我们绕过了人类受试者。相反，我们将一个通用的强化学习智能体直接与桌面循环水通道中的旋转圆柱体对接，以最大化或最小化阻力。该设置具有几个理想的特性。首先，它是一个物理系统，具有只有物理世界才有的丰富交互和复杂动力学：流动高度混沌，如果不能精确建模或模拟，则极其困难。其次，目标——阻力最小化或最大化——易于陈述，并且可以直接在奖励中捕获，但好的策略事先并不明显。第三，几十年前的实验研究提供了简单、高性能开环策略的配方。最后，该设置成本低廉，并且比人类研究更容易复制。在我们的实验中，我们发现高维流反馈可以让智能体在仅几分钟的真实世界交互中发现高性能的阻力控制策略。当我们稍后在没有任何反馈的情况下重放相同的动作序列时，我们获得了几乎相同的性能。这表明执行所学策略不需要反馈，特别是流反馈。令人惊讶的是，在没有流反馈的情况下进行训练，智能体未能发现任何表现良好的策略来最大化阻力，但在最小化阻力方面仍然成功，尽管速度较慢且效果较差。我们的研究表明，学习高性能技能可能需要比执行它更丰富的信息，并且学习条件可能仅仅取决于目标，而与动力学或策略的复杂性无关。
AI.summary: 本研究利用强化学习智能体与物理系统（循环水通道中的旋转圆柱体）交互，研究了反馈在技能学习中的作用。结果表明，在高维流反馈存在的情况下，智能体能快速学会高性能的阻力控制策略，并且在无反馈下也能良好执行。然而，在无反馈训练下，智能体在阻力最大化任务上失败，在阻力最小化任务上学习缓慢且效果不佳。这揭示了学习与执行对信息的需求可能不同，且学习条件的难易程度取决于目标。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 技能获取, 反馈, 阻力控制, 物理系统
AI.comments: 这项研究巧妙地利用了一个物理系统来探索强化学习中的反馈问题，避免了人类实验的复杂性。研究结果令人惊讶地揭示了学习和执行阶段对反馈信息的不同需求，以及目标导向对学习条件影响的重要性。然而，该研究的结论可能在多大程度上推广到更复杂的、非混沌的物理系统或更广泛的技能学习场景中，仍有待进一步探讨。

title: Quantization and Security Parameter Design for Overflow-Free Confidential FRIT
summary: This study proposes a systematic design procedure for determining the quantization gain and the security parameter in the Confidential Fictitious Reference Iterative Tuning (CFRIT), enabling overflow-free and accuracy-guaranteed encrypted controller tuning. Within an encrypted data-driven gain tuning, the range of quantization errors induced during the encoding (encryption) process can be estimated from operational data. Based on this insight, explicit analytical conditions on the quantization gain and the security parameter are derived to prevent overflow in computing over encrypted data. Furthermore, the analysis reveals a quantitative relationship between quantization-induced errors and the deviation between the gains obtained by CFRIT and non-confidential Fictitious Reference Iterative Tuning (FRIT), clarifying how parameter choice affects tuning accuracy. A numerical example verifies the proposed procedure by demonstrating that the designed parameters achieve accurate encrypted tuning within a prescribed tolerance while preventing overflow. In addition, the admissible region of parameter combinations is visualized to examine the characteristics of feasible and infeasible regions, providing practical insights into parameter design for encrypted data-driven control.

AI.title_translation: 无溢出保密FRIT的量化和安全参数设计
AI.tldr: 研究设计了一种方法来确定CFRIT中的量化和安全参数，以确保加密控制器调谐既不会溢出也不会损失太多精度。它基于分析量化误差并提供数学条件来选择最佳参数。
AI.motivation: 旨在为保密虚参考迭代调谐（CFRIT）设计一个系统化的程序，以实现无溢出且保证精度的加密控制器调谐。
AI.method: 通过分析加密编码过程中引入的量化误差的范围，并基于此推导出量化增益和安全参数的明确解析条件，以防止在加密数据计算中发生溢出。此外，还分析了量化误差与CFRIT和FRIT所得增益偏差之间的定量关系，并可视化了可行参数组合的区域。
AI.result: 得出了防止加密数据计算中溢出的量化增益和安全参数的明确解析条件，揭示了量化误差与调谐精度之间的定量关系，并通过数值示例验证了该程序，同时可视化了可行参数组合的区域。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的设计程序通过数值示例得到了验证，证明了所设计的参数能够在规定的容差内实现准确的加密调谐并防止溢出。
AI.translation: 本研究提出了一种确定保密虚参考迭代调谐（CFRIT）中量化增益和安全参数的系统设计程序，以实现无溢出和精度保证的加密控制器调谐。在加密数据驱动的增益调谐中，可以从操作数据估计编码（加密）过程中引入的量化误差的范围。基于此洞察，导出了量化增益和安全参数的明确解析条件，以防止在加密数据上进行计算时发生溢出。此外，该分析揭示了量化引起的误差与CFRIT和非保密虚参考迭代调谐（FRIT）获得的增益之间的偏差之间的定量关系，阐明了参数选择如何影响调谐精度。数值示例通过演示所设计的参数能够在规定的容差内实现准确的加密调谐并防止溢出，从而验证了所提出的程序。此外，可行参数组合的允许区域被可视化，以检查可行和不可行区域的特性，为加密数据驱动控制的参数设计提供了实际见解。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种系统化的设计程序，用于确定保密虚参考迭代调谐（CFRIT）中的量化增益和安全参数，以实现无溢出且保证精度的加密控制器调谐。该方法通过分析加密过程中的量化误差，推导出明确的解析条件来防止溢出，并量化了参数选择对调谐精度的影响。数值验证证实了该程序能实现准确的加密调谐。
AI.keywords: 保密虚参考迭代调谐, 量化增益, 安全参数, 无溢出, 加密控制
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于提出了一个系统化的设计流程，专门针对保密虚参考迭代调谐（CFRIT）中的量化和安全参数，以确保无溢出的加密控制器调谐。其重要性在于为加密数据驱动的控制设计提供了理论基础和实用指导。局限性在于分析是基于对量化误差的估计，可能依赖于操作数据的特性。

title: High-performance computing enabled contingency analysis for modern power networks
comments: 10 apges, 5 figures, pending to be submitted on IJEPES
summary: Modern power networks face increasing vulnerability to cascading failures due to high complexity and the growing penetration of intermittent resources, necessitating rigorous security assessment beyond the conventional $N-1$ criterion. Current approaches often struggle to achieve the computational tractability required for exhaustive $N-2$ contingency analysis integrated with complex stability evaluations like small-signal stability. Addressing this computational bottleneck and the limitations of deterministic screening, this paper presents a scalable methodology for the vulnerability assessment of modern power networks, integrating $N-2$ contingency analysis with small-signal stability evaluation. To prioritize critical components, we propose a probabilistic \textbf{Risk Index ($R_i$)} that weights the deterministic \textit{severity} of a contingency (including optimal power flow divergence, islanding, and oscillatory instability) by the \textit{failure frequency} of the involved elements based on reliability data. The proposed framework is implemented using High-Performance Computing (HPC) techniques through the PyCOMPSs parallel programming library, orchestrating optimal power flow simulations (VeraGrid) and small-signal analysis (STAMP) to enable the exhaustive exploration of massive contingency sets. The methodology is validated on the IEEE 118-bus test system, processing more than \num{57000} scenarios to identify components prone to triggering cascading failures. Results demonstrate that the risk-based approach effectively isolates critical assets that deterministic $N-1$ criteria often overlook. This work establishes a replicable and efficient workflow for probabilistic security assessment, suitable for large-scale networks and capable of supporting operator decision-making in near real-time environments.
comment: 10 apges, 5 figures, pending to be submitted on IJEPES

AI.title_translation: 高性能计算支持的现代电网应急分析
AI.tldr: 为了更好地评估现代电网的级联故障风险，研究人员开发了一种利用高性能计算（HPC）来同时进行 N-2 故障分析和小信号稳定性评估的新方法。他们引入了一个概率风险指数 ($R_i$)，该指数结合了故障的严重性和元件的失效频率。该方法在测试系统中成功处理了数万个场景，比传统的 N-1 标准更有效地找到了关键的薄弱环节。
AI.motivation: 现代电网因高复杂性和间歇性资源的增加而面临级联故障的脆弱性增加，这要求进行严格的安全评估，超越传统的 N-1 标准。当前方法在实现集成复杂稳定性评估（如小信号稳定性）的穷举 N-2 故障分析所需的计算可行性方面存在困难。
AI.method: 提出了一种概率风险指数 ($R_i$) 来加权确定性严重性（包括最优潮流发散、孤岛和振荡不稳定性）与基于可靠性数据的故障元件失效频率。该框架使用 PyCOMPSs 并行编程库实现的 HPC 技术，编排了最优潮流模拟 (VeraGrid) 和小信号分析 (STAMP) 来穷尽地探索大规模故障集。
AI.result: 该方法在 IEEE 118 节点测试系统上进行了验证，处理了超过 57000 个场景，成功识别了易于引发级联故障的组件。结果表明，基于风险的方法能有效隔离传统确定性 N-1 标准经常忽略的关键资产。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一个可复制且高效的概率安全评估工作流程，适用于大规模电网，并能够在近实时环境中支持运营商的决策制定。
AI.translation: 现代电力网络因高复杂性和间歇性资源的日益渗透，面临着由级联故障引起的脆弱性增加，这要求进行超越传统 N-1 标准的严格安全评估。当前的方法通常难以实现与复杂稳定性评估（如小信号稳定性）相结合的穷举 N-2 应急分析所需的计算可行性。为解决这一计算瓶颈和确定性筛选的局限性，本文提出了一种可扩展的现代电力网络脆弱性评估方法，将 N-2 应急分析与小信号稳定性评估相结合。为确定关键元件的优先级，我们提出了一个概率**风险指数 ($R_i$)**，它根据可靠性数据，用所涉及元件的**失效频率**来加权确定性**严重性**（包括最优潮流发散、孤岛和振荡不稳定性）。所提出的框架通过 PyCOMPSs 并行编程库使用高性能计算（HPC）技术实现，编排最优潮流模拟（VeraGrid）和小信号分析（STAMP），以实现对海量应急场景的穷举探索。该方法在 IEEE 118 节点测试系统上进行了验证，处理了超过 57000 个场景，以识别易于引发级联故障的元件。结果表明，基于风险的方法能有效隔离传统确定性 N-1 标准经常忽略的关键资产。这项工作建立了一个可复制且高效的概率安全评估工作流程，适用于大规模网络，并能够在近实时环境中支持运营商的决策制定。
AI.summary: 为解决现代电网中因级联故障风险增加而对更严格安全评估的需求，本文提出了一种可扩展的、集成 N-2 故障分析与小信号稳定性评估的漏洞评估方法。该方法引入了概率风险指数 ($R_i$)，并利用 HPC 技术（PyCOMPSs）实现了大规模、高效率的计算。验证结果表明，该风险方法能有效识别关键资产，为大规模电网提供近实时决策支持。
AI.keywords: 高计算性能, N-2 故障分析, 小信号稳定性, 风险指数, 电力系统安全
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将N-2/小信号稳定性分析与概率风险指标$R_i$相结合，并利用HPC技术解决了大规模计算的可行性问题。重要性在于它提供了一种超越传统N-1标准的、更精细化的安全评估方法。局限性可能在于对可靠性数据的依赖性，以及HPC环境的部署复杂性。

title: Team-Aware Football Player Tracking with SAM: An Appearance-Based Approach to Occlusion Recovery
summary: Football player tracking is challenged by frequent occlusions, similar appearances, and rapid motion in crowded scenes. This paper presents a lightweight SAM-based tracking method combining the Segment Anything Model (SAM) with CSRT trackers and jersey color-based appearance models. We propose a team-aware tracking system that uses SAM for precise initialization and HSV histogram-based re-identification to improve occlusion recovery. Our evaluation measures three dimensions: processing speed (FPS and memory), tracking accuracy (success rate and box stability), and robustness (occlusion recovery and identity consistency). Experiments on football video sequences show that the approach achieves 7.6-7.7 FPS with stable memory usage (~1880 MB), maintaining 100 percent tracking success in light occlusions and 90 percent in crowded penalty-box scenarios with 5 or more players. Appearance-based re-identification recovers 50 percent of heavy occlusions, demonstrating the value of domain-specific cues. Analysis reveals key trade-offs: the SAM + CSRT combination provides consistent performance across crowd densities but struggles with long-term occlusions where players leave the frame, achieving only 8.66 percent re-acquisition success. These results offer practical guidelines for deploying football tracking systems under resource constraints, showing that classical tracker-based methods work well with continuous visibility but require stronger re-identification mechanisms for extended absences.

AI.title_translation: 基于SAM的团队感知足球运动员跟踪：一种基于外观的方法用于遮挡恢复
AI.tldr: 为了解决足球跟踪中的遮挡问题，研究人员将SAM、CSRT跟踪器和基于球衣颜色的重识别结合起来，实现了快速（~7.7 FPS）且在大多数情况下准确的跟踪，但在球员长时间消失后重识别效果不佳。
AI.motivation: 足球运动员跟踪面临频繁的遮挡、相似的外观和拥挤场景中的快速运动等挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种轻量级的基于SAM的跟踪方法，结合了Segment Anything Model (SAM)、CSRT跟踪器和基于球衣颜色的外观模型。系统使用SAM进行精确初始化，并使用基于HSV直方图的重识别来改进遮挡恢复。评估维度包括处理速度、跟踪精度和鲁棒性。
AI.result: 该方法实现了7.6-7.7 FPS的处理速度，内存使用稳定在约1880 MB。在轻度遮挡下保持100%的跟踪成功率，在拥挤的禁区场景（5名或更多球员）中达到90%。基于外观的重识别成功恢复了50%的重度遮挡。然而，SAM + CSRT组合在长期遮挡（球员离开画面）的情况下，重获取成功率仅为8.66%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，基于经典跟踪器的传统方法在连续可见性下表现良好，但需要更强的重识别机制来应对长时间的缺席情况。结果为资源受限的足球跟踪系统部署提供了实际指导。
AI.translation: 足球运动员跟踪面临频繁的遮挡、相似的外观和拥挤场景中的快速运动等挑战。本文提出了一种轻量级的基于SAM的跟踪方法，结合了Segment Anything Model (SAM) 与 CSRT 跟踪器以及基于球衣颜色的外观模型。我们提出了一种团队感知的跟踪系统，使用 SAM 进行精确初始化，并使用基于 HSV 直方图的重识别来改进遮挡恢复。我们的评估衡量了三个维度：处理速度（FPS 和内存）、跟踪精度（成功率和盒子稳定性）以及鲁棒性（遮挡恢复和身份一致性）。在足球视频序列上的实验表明，该方法实现了 7.6-7.7 FPS 的处理速度，内存使用稳定（~1880 MB），在轻度遮挡下保持 100% 的跟踪成功率，在拥挤的禁区场景（5 名或更多球员）中达到 90%。基于外观的重识别恢复了 50% 的重度遮挡，证明了领域特定线索的价值。分析揭示了关键的权衡：SAM + CSRT 的组合在不同人群密度下提供了稳定的性能，但在长期遮挡（球员离开画面）的情况下表现不佳，重获取成功率仅为 8.66%。这些结果为资源受限下的足球跟踪系统部署提供了实际指导，表明经典跟踪器方法在连续可见性下工作良好，但需要更强的重识别机制来应对长时间的缺席。
AI.summary: 该文提出了一种名为“团队感知”的轻量级足球运动员跟踪方法，该方法集成了SAM进行精确初始化、CSRT跟踪器以及基于HSV直方图的团队感知重识别模块，以有效应对足球比赛中常见的遮挡问题。实验证明了该方法在速度和精度上的平衡表现，尤其是在重识别方面展现了提升鲁棒性的潜力，但也指出了其在处理长期遮挡时的局限性。
AI.keywords: 足球跟踪, 遮挡恢复, SAM, CSRT, 外观模型
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地结合了SAM的精确初始化能力与CSRT跟踪器，并引入了基于球衣颜色的团队感知重识别机制来增强遮挡恢复能力。其局限性在于对于长时间离开视窗的球员重获取率较低。该工作为资源受限环境下的足球跟踪系统提供了实用的部署指导。

title: Measuring Computer Science Enthusiasm: A Questionnaire-Based Analysis of Age and Gender Effects on Students' Interest
comments: 20 pages, 10 figures, Springer Nature Scientific Reports in review
summary: This study offers new insights into students' interest in computer science (CS) education by disentangling the distinct effects of age and gender across a diverse adolescent sample. Grounded in the person-object theory of interest (POI), we conceptualize enthusiasm as a short-term, activating expression of interest that combines positive affect, perceived relevance, and intention to re-engage. Experiencing such enthusiasm can temporarily shift CS attitudes and strengthen future engagement intentions, making it a valuable lens for evaluating brief outreach activities. To capture these dynamics, we developed a theoretically grounded questionnaire for pre-post assessment of the enthusiasm potential of CS interventions. Using data from more than 400 students participating in online CS courses, we examined age- and gender-related patterns in enthusiasm. The findings challenge the prevailing belief that early exposure is the primary pathway to sustained interest in CS. Instead, we identify a marked decline in enthusiasm during early adolescence, particularly among girls, alongside substantial variability in interest trajectories across age groups. Crucially, our analyses reveal that age is a more decisive factor than gender in shaping interest development and uncover key developmental breakpoints. Despite starting with lower baseline attitudes, older students showed the largest positive changes following the intervention, suggesting that well-designed short activities can effectively re-activate interest even at later ages. Overall, the study highlights the need for a dynamic, age-sensitive framework for CS education in which instructional strategies are aligned with developmental trajectories.
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, Springer Nature Scientific Reports in review

AI.title_translation: 衡量计算机科学热情：一项基于问卷的关于年龄和性别对学生兴趣影响的分析
AI.tldr: 通过问卷分析了400多名学生，发现CS兴趣在青春期早期（女孩中尤甚）下降，年龄比性别更能决定兴趣发展轨迹。年龄较大的学生对短期干预反应最好，强调CS教育需要根据学生年龄进行动态调整。
AI.motivation: 为了深入了解学生对计算机科学（CS）教育的兴趣，通过解开年龄和性别对青少年样本中热情（短期的、激活性的兴趣表达）的独立影响。评估CS干预措施的潜力，因为热情可以暂时改变CS态度并加强未来的参与意图。
AI.method: 开发了一个基于理论的问卷，用于CS干预措施的售前和售后评估，以衡量热情（结合积极情感、感知相关性和再参与意图）。使用来自400多名参与在线CS课程的学生的样本，检验了与年龄和性别相关的热情模式。
AI.result: 研究发现热情在青春期早期显著下降，尤其是在女孩中，并且兴趣轨迹在不同年龄组之间存在很大差异。年龄比性别更能决定兴趣发展，并揭示了关键的发展断点。尽管年龄较大的学生基线态度较低，但他们在干预后显示出最大的积极变化。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了CS教育需要一个动态的、对年龄敏感的框架，教学策略应与学生的发展轨迹保持一致，并且设计良好的短期活动即使在年龄较大的学生中也能有效重新激发兴趣。
AI.translation: 本研究通过解开年龄和性别对多样化青少年样本中兴趣的独立影响，为学生对计算机科学（CS）教育的兴趣提供了新的见解。我们基于人的对象理论（POI），将热情概念化为结合了积极情感、感知相关性和再参与意图的短期、激活性的兴趣表达。体验到这种热情可以暂时改变CS态度并加强未来的参与意图，使其成为评估简短外展活动的宝贵视角。为了捕捉这些动态，我们开发了一个基于理论的问卷，用于CS干预措施的售前和售后评估。使用来自400多名参与在线CS课程的学生的样本，我们检验了与年龄和性别相关的热情模式。研究结果挑战了早期接触是持续CS兴趣主要途径的普遍信念。相反，我们发现热情在青春期早期有明显的下降，尤其是在女孩中，并且兴趣轨迹在不同年龄组之间存在很大的差异。至关重要的是，我们的分析揭示了年龄是塑造兴趣发展比性别更具决定性的因素，并发现了关键的发展断点。尽管年龄较大的学生基线态度较低，但他们在干预后显示出最大的积极变化，这表明设计良好的短期活动即使在较大的年龄也能有效地重新激活兴趣。总体而言，这项研究强调了CS教育需要一个动态的、对年龄敏感的框架，其中教学策略应与发展轨迹保持一致。
AI.summary: 本研究开发了一种基于POI理论的问卷，用于衡量青少年对计算机科学（CS）的“热情”（短期兴趣表达）。对400多名学生的分析发现，与普遍看法相反，年龄是影响兴趣发展的更主要因素，青春期早期（尤其是女孩）热情显著下降。研究表明，设计良好的短期干预措施可以有效地重新激发较大年龄学生对CS的兴趣。
AI.keywords: 计算机科学热情, 年龄效应, 性别效应, 兴趣理论, CS教育
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于，它基于POI理论来量化“热情”这一短暂但重要的兴趣表达形式，并系统地解耦了年龄和性别的影响，挑战了“早期接触是关键”的传统观点。其重要性在于为CS教育干预措施的有效性评估提供了一个敏感的、基于发展的评估框架。局限性是研究仅基于问卷数据和短期干预效果。

title: Solving Over-Smoothing in GNNs via Nonlocal Message Passing: Algebraic Smoothing and Depth Scalability
summary:
The relationship between Layer Normalization (LN) placement and the over-smoothing phenomenon remains underexplored. We identify a critical dilemma: Pre-LN architectures avoid over-smoothing but suffer from the curse of depth, while Post-LN architectures bypass the curse of depth but experience over-smoothing.
  To resolve this, we propose a new method based on Post-LN that induces algebraic smoothing, preventing over-smoothing without the curse of depth. Empirical results across five benchmarks demonstrate that our approach supports deeper networks (up to 256 layers) and improves performance, requiring no additional parameters.
  Key contributions:
  Theoretical Characterization: Analysis of LN dynamics and their impact on over-smoothing and the curse of depth.
  A Principled Solution: A parameter-efficient method that induces algebraic smoothing and avoids over-smoothing and the curse of depth.
  Empirical Validation: Extensive experiments showing the effectiveness of the method in deeper GNNs.

AI.title_translation: 通过非局部消息传递解决GNN中的过平滑问题：代数平滑与深度可扩展性
AI.tldr: GNN中的LN放置存在两难：Pre-LN抗过平滑但深度受限，Post-LN深度好但易过平滑。作者提出了一个Post-LN的新方法，通过诱导“代数平滑”来同时解决这两个问题，使得GNN可以扩展到256层而性能更佳，且无需额外参数。
AI.motivation: 现有的GNN架构中，前置LN（Pre-LN）能避免过平滑但受深度诅咒限制，而后置LN（Post-LN）能克服深度诅咒但会遭受过平滑，这种关键困境亟待解决。
AI.method: 提出一种基于后置层归一化（Post-LN）的新方法，通过诱导代数平滑（algebraic smoothing）来防止过平滑，同时避免深度诅咒。
AI.result: 该方法支持了高达256层的更深网络，并在五个基准测试中提升了性能，且无需额外参数。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功地解决了GNN中层归一化放置带来的过平滑与深度诅咒之间的矛盾，支持了多达256层的深度网络，并在不增加参数的情况下提升了性能。
AI.translation: 层归一化（LN）的位置与过平滑现象之间的关系仍有待深入探索。我们发现了一个关键的两难境地：前置LN（Pre-LN）架构可以避免过平滑，但会遭受深度诅咒；而后置LN（Post-LN）架构可以绕过深度诅咒，但会经历过平滑。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种基于后置LN的新方法，该方法诱导代数平滑，从而在不产生深度诅咒的情况下防止过平滑。跨五个基准的实证结果表明，我们方法支持更深的网络（高达256层）并提高了性能，且无需额外参数。主要贡献包括：理论表征（分析LN动态及其对过平滑和深度诅咒的影响）、一个引入代数平滑并避免过平滑和深度诅咒的原则性解决方案，以及在更深GNN中验证有效性的广泛实验。
AI.summary: 本文分析了层归一化（LN）位置与GNN中过平滑和深度诅咒之间的关键权衡。作者提出了一种基于后置LN的新方法，通过诱导“代数平滑”来同时解决过平滑问题和深度诅咒，并在实验中验证了其支持极深网络（高达256层）的有效性，且不引入额外参数。
AI.keywords: 图神经网络, 过平滑, 层归一化, 深度可扩展性, 代数平滑
AI.comments: 该论文的核心创新在于揭示了层归一化（LN）位置与图神经网络（GNNs）中过平滑（over-smoothing）和深度诅咒（curse of depth）之间的关键权衡。作者提出了一种基于后置LN（Post-LN）的新方法，通过诱导“代数平滑”（algebraic smoothing）来解决这一困境，使得模型能够在不牺牲深度的情况下抵抗过平滑，且无需额外参数，这在深度可扩展性方面具有重要意义。

title: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Design Space Exploration in Autonomous Driving Systems
summary: Designing autonomous driving systems requires efficient exploration of large hardware/software configuration spaces under diverse environmental conditions, e.g., with varying traffic, weather, and road layouts. Traditional design space exploration (DSE) approaches struggle with multi-modal execution outputs and complex performance trade-offs, and often require human involvement to assess correctness based on execution outputs. This paper presents a multi-agent, large language model (LLM)-based DSE framework, which integrates multi-modal reasoning with 3D simulation and profiling tools to automate the interpretation of execution outputs and guide the exploration of system designs. Specialized LLM agents are leveraged to handle user input interpretation, design point generation, execution orchestration, and analysis of both visual and textual execution outputs, which enables identification of potential bottlenecks without human intervention. A prototype implementation is developed and evaluated on a robotaxi case study (an SAE Level 4 autonomous driving application). Compared with a genetic algorithm baseline, the proposed framework identifies more Pareto-optimal, cost-efficient solutions with reduced navigation time under the same exploration budget. Experimental results also demonstrate the efficiency of the adoption of the LLM-based approach for DSE. We believe that this framework paves the way to the design automation of autonomous driving systems.

AI.title_translation: 用于自动驾驶系统设计空间探索的多智能体大语言模型框架
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个基于多智能体大语言模型（LLM）的设计空间探索（DSE）框架，用于自动驾驶系统。该框架通过集成多模态推理、3D仿真和性能分析工具，自动化了对执行输出的解释，并指导系统设计探索。与遗传算法相比，该框架在相同的探索预算下，能够识别出更多帕累托最优、更具成本效益且导航时间更短的解决方案，证明了LLM在DSE中的效率。
AI.motivation: 传统的设计空间探索（DSE）方法在处理多模态执行输出和复杂的性能权衡方面存在困难，并且通常需要人工干预来评估基于执行输出的正确性。
AI.method: 提出并实现了一个多智能体、大语言模型（LLM）驱动的DSE框架。该框架利用专门的LLM智能体来处理用户输入解释、设计点生成、执行编排以及视觉和文本执行输出的分析，并结合了3D仿真和性能分析工具。
AI.result: 与遗传算法基线相比，该框架在相同的探索预算下，识别出更多帕累托最优、更具成本效益且导航时间更短的解决方案。实验结果证明了LLM在DSE中的效率。
AI.conclusion: 该多智能体LLM框架能够自动化自动驾驶系统的设计空间探索，识别出更优的解决方案，并为自动驾驶系统的设计自动化铺平了道路。
AI.translation: 设计自动驾驶系统需要在多样化的环境条件下（例如，不同的交通、天气和道路布局）高效地探索庞大的软硬件配置空间。传统的 DSE 方法在处理多模态执行输出和复杂的性能权衡方面存在困难，并且通常需要人工干预来根据执行输出来评估正确性。本文提出了一个多智能体、基于大语言模型（LLM）的 DSE 框架，它集成了多模态推理与 3D 仿真和性能分析工具，以自动化解释执行输出并指导系统设计探索。利用专门的 LLM 智能体来处理用户输入解释、设计点生成、执行编排以及视觉和文本执行输出的分析，从而能够在没有人为干预的情况下识别潜在的瓶颈。我们实现了一个原型系统，并在机器人出租车案例研究（SAE Level 4 自动驾驶应用）上进行了评估。与遗传算法基线相比，在相同的探索预算下，所提出的框架能够识别出更多帕累托最优、更具成本效益且导航时间更短的解决方案。实验结果也证明了采用基于 LLM 的方法进行 DSE 的效率。我们相信，该框架为自动驾驶系统的设计自动化铺平了道路。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种创新的多智能体大语言模型（LLM）框架，用于解决自动驾驶系统设计空间探索（DSE）中的挑战。该框架通过整合LLM智能体进行任务分解（如用户输入解释、设计生成、执行控制和结果分析）和多模态推理，结合3D仿真和性能分析工具，实现了DSE过程的自动化。实验结果表明，与传统方法（如遗传算法）相比，该框架能在相同的资源限制下发现更优的设计方案，显著提高了DSE的效率和效果。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶系统, 设计空间探索, 大语言模型, 多智能体, 性能优化
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的方法，将LLM应用于自动驾驶系统的设计空间探索，解决了传统方法在处理复杂性和自动化方面的局限性。通过使用多智能体架构和集成仿真工具，该框架能够有效地探索设计空间并找到更优的解决方案。然而，对于LLM在实际大规模应用中的可扩展性、鲁棒性以及潜在的计算成本，还需要进一步的研究和评估。

title: ContextDrag: Precise Drag-Based Image Editing via Context-Preserving Token Injection and Position-Consistent Attention
summary: Drag-based image editing aims to modify visual content followed by user-specified drag operations. Despite existing methods having made notable progress, they still fail to fully exploit the contextual information in the reference image, including fine-grained texture details, leading to edits with limited coherence and fidelity. To address this challenge, we introduce ContextDrag, a new paradigm for drag-based editing that leverages the strong contextual modeling capability of editing models, such as FLUX-Kontext. By incorporating VAE-encoded features from the reference image, ContextDrag can leverage rich contextual cues and preserve fine-grained details, without the need for finetuning or inversion. Specifically, ContextDrag introduced a novel Context-preserving Token Injection (CTI) that injects noise-free reference features into their correct destination locations via a Latent-space Reverse Mapping (LRM) algorithm. This strategy enables precise drag control while preserving consistency in both semantics and texture details. Second, ContextDrag adopts a novel Position-Consistent Attention (PCA), which positional re-encodes the reference tokens and applies overlap-aware masking to eliminate interference from irrelevant reference features. Extensive experiments on DragBench-SR and DragBench-DR demonstrate that our approach surpasses all existing SOTA methods. Code will be publicly available.

AI.title_translation: ContextDrag：通过上下文保持的令牌注入和位置一致性注意力实现精确的拖放式图像编辑
AI.tldr: ContextDrag 通过注入 VAE 编码的参考图像特征，并使用位置一致性注意力，实现了精确的拖放式图像编辑，能够保留精细的纹理细节，并在 DragBench-SR 和 DragBench-DR 数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有拖放式图像编辑方法未能充分利用参考图像的上下文信息，包括精细的纹理细节，导致编辑结果缺乏连贯性和保真度。
AI.method: ContextDrag 引入了一种新的上下文保持令牌注入（CTI）方法，利用潜在空间反向映射（LRM）算法将无噪声的参考特征注入到正确的目标位置。此外，它还采用了位置一致性注意力（PCA）机制，通过位置重新编码参考令牌并应用重叠感知掩码来消除无关参考特征的干扰。
AI.result: ContextDrag 在 DragBench-SR 和 DragBench-DR 数据集上的实验表明，该方法在精确拖放控制和细节保留方面优于所有现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: ContextDrag 通过上下文保持的令牌注入和位置一致性注意力，能够有效地利用上下文信息，实现高保真度的拖放式图像编辑，并在各项基准测试中取得领先成果。
AI.translation: 拖放式图像编辑旨在修改遵循用户指定拖放操作的视觉内容。尽管现有方法已取得显著进展，但它们仍未能充分利用参考图像中的上下文信息，包括精细的纹理细节，导致编辑结果连贯性和保真度有限。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了 ContextDrag，一种用于拖放式编辑的新范例，它利用了像 FLUX-Kontext 这样的编辑模型的强大上下文建模能力。通过整合来自参考图像的 VAE 编码特征，ContextDrag 可以利用丰富的上下文线索并保留精细的细节，而无需进行微调或反演。具体来说，ContextDrag 引入了一种新颖的上下文保持令牌注入（CTI），它通过潜在空间反向映射（LRM）算法将无噪声的参考特征注入到其正确的目标位置。这种策略可在保留语义和纹理细节一致性的同时，实现精确的拖放控制。其次，ContextDrag 采用了新颖的位置一致性注意力（PCA），它对参考令牌进行位置重新编码，并应用重叠感知掩码来消除无关参考特征的干扰。在 DragBench-SR 和 DragBench-DR 上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法超越了所有现有的最先进方法。代码将公开发布。
AI.summary: ContextDrag 是一种新的拖放式图像编辑方法，它通过 VAE 编码的特征注入和位置一致性注意力，有效利用上下文信息，实现精确的编辑控制并保留精细的纹理细节，无需微调或反演，并在实验中超越了现有最先进方法。
AI.keywords: 拖放式图像编辑, 上下文保持, 令牌注入, 位置一致性注意力, 细节保留
AI.comments: 该方法通过引入 CTI 和 PCA 机制，有效地解决了现有拖放式编辑方法在上下文信息利用和细节保留方面的不足，具有重要的研究意义和应用价值。代码公开的承诺也增加了其可复现性和影响力。

title: Visionary: The World Model Carrier Built on WebGPU-Powered Gaussian Splatting Platform
summary: Neural rendering, particularly 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), has evolved rapidly and become a key component for building world models. However, existing viewer solutions remain fragmented, heavy, or constrained by legacy pipelines, resulting in high deployment friction and limited support for dynamic content and generative models. In this work, we present Visionary, an open, web-native platform for real-time various Gaussian Splatting and meshes rendering. Built on an efficient WebGPU renderer with per-frame ONNX inference, Visionary enables dynamic neural processing while maintaining a lightweight, "click-to-run" browser experience. It introduces a standardized Gaussian Generator contract, which not only supports standard 3DGS rendering but also allows plug-and-play algorithms to generate or update Gaussians each frame. Such inference also enables us to apply feedforward generative post-processing. The platform further offers a plug in three.js library with a concise TypeScript API for seamless integration into existing web applications. Experiments show that, under identical 3DGS assets, Visionary achieves superior rendering efficiency compared to current Web viewers due to GPU-based primitive sorting. It already supports multiple variants, including MLP-based 3DGS, 4DGS, neural avatars, and style transformation or enhancement networks. By unifying inference and rendering directly in the browser, Visionary significantly lowers the barrier to reproduction, comparison, and deployment of 3DGS-family methods, serving as a unified World Model Carrier for both reconstructive and generative paradigms.

AI.title_translation: 远见：基于WebGPU高斯喷涂平台的万能世界模型载体
AI.tldr: Visionary是一个开源的、Web原生的平台，使用WebGPU进行高斯喷涂和网格渲染，支持动态神经网络处理和生成式后处理，降低了3DGS方法部署和复现的门槛。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D高斯喷涂查看器存在碎片化、笨重或受限于传统流程的问题，导致部署困难，并且对动态内容和生成模型支持有限。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于WebGPU的高效渲染器，并结合逐帧ONNX推理，实现了动态神经处理。引入了标准化的高斯生成器合约，支持标准3DGS渲染和即插即用的高斯生成/更新算法。平台还提供了一个three.js插件，具有简洁的TypeScript API。
AI.result: Visionary在相同的3DGS资产下，由于基于GPU的图元排序，渲染效率优于现有的Web查看器。它支持MLP-based 3DGS、4DGS、神经头像以及风格转换或增强网络等多种变体。
AI.conclusion: Visionary通过在浏览器中统一推理和渲染，显著降低了3DGS系列方法复现、比较和部署的门槛，可作为重建和生成范式统一的世界模型载体。
AI.translation: 神经渲染，特别是3D高斯喷涂（3DGS），发展迅速，已成为构建世界模型的关键组成部分。然而，现有的查看器解决方案仍然分散、笨重或受限于传统流程，导致部署摩擦高，并且对动态内容和生成模型的支持有限。在本研究中，我们提出了Visionary，一个开源的、Web原生的平台，用于实时各种高斯喷涂和网格渲染。Visionary基于高效的WebGPU渲染器，并结合逐帧ONNX推理，实现了动态神经处理，同时保持了轻量级的“即点即运行”浏览器体验。它引入了一个标准化的高斯生成器合约，不仅支持标准的3DGS渲染，还允许即插即用的算法在每一帧生成或更新高斯。这种推理也使我们能够应用前馈生成式后处理。该平台还提供了一个three.js库插件，具有简洁的TypeScript API，可无缝集成到现有的Web应用程序中。实验表明，在相同的3DGS资产下，Visionary由于基于GPU的图元排序，其渲染效率优于当前的Web查看器。它已经支持多种变体，包括基于MLP的3DGS、4DGS、神经头像以及风格转换或增强网络。通过在浏览器中直接统一推理和渲染，Visionary显著降低了3DGS系列方法复现、比较和部署的门槛，可作为重建和生成范式统一的世界模型载体。
AI.summary: Visionary是一个创新的、Web原生的平台，利用WebGPU和ONNX推理技术，实现了高效的3D高斯喷涂（3DGS）渲染和动态神经网络处理。该平台解决了现有3DGS查看器分散、笨重和部署困难的问题，提供了一个轻量级、即插即用的解决方案，支持实时渲染、生成式后处理以及多种3DGS变体。通过提供标准化的接口和易于集成的API，Visionary极大地降低了3DGS方法的复现、比较和部署门槛，有望成为统一的3D世界模型载体。
AI.keywords: 3D高斯喷涂, WebGPU, 神经渲染, 世界模型, 浏览器平台
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为Visionary的创新平台，它利用WebGPU和ONNX推理技术，在浏览器中实现了高效的3D高斯喷涂（3DGS）渲染和动态神经网络处理。该平台解决了现有3DGS查看器在性能、易用性和对动态内容支持方面的不足，通过其轻量级、即插即用的特性，极大地降低了3DGS方法的部署和复现门槛。其GPU加速的图元排序和对多种3DGS变体的支持是该研究的重要亮点。然而，虽然该平台在渲染效率和易用性方面取得了显著进展，但其在处理大规模或极其复杂的动态场景时的长期稳定性和性能上限仍有待进一步探索。

title: Construction and Performance of Kinetic Schemes for Linear Systems of Conservation Laws
summary: We describe a methodology to build vectorial kinetic schemes, targetting the numerical solution of linear symmetric-hyperbolic systems of conservation laws -a minimal application case for those schemes. Precisely, we fully detail the construction of kinetic schemes that satisfy a discrete equivalent to a convex extension (an additional non-trivial conservation law) of the target system -the (linear) acoustic and elastodynamics systems, specifically -. Then, we evaluate numerically the convergence of various possible kinetic schemes toward smooth solutions, in comparison with standard finite-difference and finite-volume discretizations on Cartesian meshes. Our numerical results confirm the interest of ensuring a discrete equivalent to a convex extension, and show the influence of remaining parameter variations in terms of error magnitude, both for ''first-order'' and ''second-order'' kinetic schemes\,: the parameter choice with largest CFL number (equiv., smallest spurious diffusion in the equivalent equation analysis) has the smallest discretization error.

AI.title_translation: 线性守恒律的动理学格式的构建与性能
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一种新的动理学格式构建方法，专门针对线性守恒律系统，并通过数值实验证明，满足特定“凸延拓”条件的格式更优，且最大CFL数参数选择误差最小。
AI.motivation: 为线性对称双曲型守恒律的数值解构建矢量动理学格式，并将其作为这些格式的最小应用案例。
AI.method: 构建满足目标系统离散等效凸延拓的矢量动理学格式，并在笛卡尔网格上使用数值方法评估其收敛性，与标准有限差分和有限体积离散化进行比较。
AI.result: 数值结果证实了确保离散等效凸延拓的益处，并表明最大CFL数（最小虚假扩散）的参数选择产生了最小的离散误差。
AI.conclusion: 数值结果证实了确保离散等效凸延拓的价值，并展示了剩余参数变化对误差大小的影响，最优参数选择（最大CFL数，即等效方程分析中最小的虚假扩散）产生的离散误差最小。
AI.translation: 我们描述了一种构建矢量动理学格式的方法，目标是线性对称双曲型守恒律的数值解——这些格式的一个最小应用案例。具体来说，我们详细介绍了满足目标系统（特别是（线性）声学和弹性动力学系统）的凸延拓的离散等效的动理学格式的构建。然后，我们在笛卡尔网格上，数值评估了各种可能的动理学格式向光滑解收敛的情况，并与标准有限差分和有限体积离散化进行了比较。我们的数值结果证实了确保离散等效凸延拓的意义，并显示了剩余参数变化在误差大小方面的影响，无论是对于“一阶”还是“二阶”动理学格式：具有最大CFL数（即等效方程分析中最小的虚假扩散）的参数选择具有最小的离散误差。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种构建矢量动理学格式的方法，旨在数值求解线性对称双曲型守恒律。该方法侧重于构造满足目标系统（如声学和弹性动力学系统）离散等效凸延拓的动理学格式。通过与标准方法的数值比较，结果验证了包含离散凸延拓的优势，并确定了在不同阶数的格式中，最大CFL数的参数选择能获得最小的离散误差。
AI.keywords: 动理学格式, 线性守恒律, 对称双曲系统, 凸延拓, 数值分析

title: Soft Inductive Bias Approach via Explicit Reasoning Perspectives in Inappropriate Utterance Detection Using Large Language Models
comments: in Chinese language, Published in the Proceedings of the 37th Annual Conference on Human and Language Technology, 2025, pp. 714-719. (English translation assisted by GPT)
summary: Recent incidents in certain online games and communities, where anonymity is guaranteed, show that unchecked inappropriate remarks frequently escalate into verbal abuse and even criminal behavior, raising significant social concerns. Consequently, there is a growing need for research on techniques that can detect inappropriate utterances within conversational texts to help build a safer communication environment. Although large-scale language models trained on Korean corpora and chain-of-thought reasoning have recently gained attention, research applying these approaches to inappropriate utterance detection remains limited. In this study, we propose a soft inductive bias approach that explicitly defines reasoning perspectives to guide the inference process, thereby promoting rational decision-making and preventing errors that may arise during reasoning. We fine-tune a Korean large language model using the proposed method and conduct both quantitative performance comparisons and qualitative evaluations across different training strategies. Experimental results show that the Kanana-1.5 model achieves an average accuracy of 87.0046, improving by approximately 3.89 percent over standard supervised learning. These findings indicate that the proposed method goes beyond simple knowledge imitation by large language models and enables more precise and consistent judgments through constrained reasoning perspectives, demonstrating its effectiveness for inappropriate utterance detection.

title: Prospect Theory in Physical Human-Robot Interaction: A Pilot Study of Probability Perception
summary: Understanding how humans respond to uncertainty is critical for designing safe and effective physical human-robot interaction (pHRI), as physically working with robots introduces multiple sources of uncertainty, including trust, comfort, and perceived safety. Conventional pHRI control frameworks typically build on optimal control theory, which assumes that human actions minimize a cost function; however, human behavior under uncertainty often departs from such optimal patterns. To address this gap, additional understanding of human behavior under uncertainty is needed. This pilot study implemented a physically coupled target-reaching task in which the robot delivered assistance or disturbances with systematically varied probabilities (10\% to 90\%). Analysis of participants' force inputs and decision-making strategies revealed two distinct behavioral clusters: a "trade-off" group that modulated their physical responses according to disturbance likelihood, and an "always-compensate" group characterized by strong risk aversion irrespective of probability. These findings provide empirical evidence that human decision-making in pHRI is highly individualized and that the perception of probability can differ to its true value. Accordingly, the study highlights the need for more interpretable behavioral models, such as cumulative prospect theory (CPT), to more accurately capture these behaviors and inform the design of future adaptive robot controllers.

title: NeurIDA: Dynamic Modeling for Effective In-Database Analytics
summary:
Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS) manage complex, interrelated data and support a broad spectrum of analytical tasks. With the growing demand for predictive analytics, the deep integration of machine learning (ML) into RDBMS has become critical. However, a fundamental challenge hinders this evolution: conventional ML models are static and task-specific, whereas RDBMS environments are dynamic and must support diverse analytical queries. Each analytical task entails constructing a bespoke pipeline from scratch, which incurs significant development overhead and hence limits wide adoption of ML in analytics.
  We present NeurIDA, an autonomous end-to-end system for in-database analytics that dynamically "tweaks" the best available base model to better serve a given analytical task. In particular, we propose a novel paradigm of dynamic in-database modeling to pre-train a composable base model architecture over the relational data. Upon receiving a task, NeurIDA formulates the task and data profile to dynamically select and configure relevant components from the pool of base models and shared model components for prediction. For friendly user experience, NeurIDA supports natural language queries; it interprets user intent to construct structured task profiles, and generates analytical reports with dedicated LLM agents. By design, NeurIDA enables ease-of-use and yet effective and efficient in-database AI analytics. Extensive experiment study shows that NeurIDA consistently delivers up to 12% improvement in AUC-ROC and 25% relative reduction in MAE across ten tasks on five real-world datasets. The source code is available at https://github.com/Zrealshadow/NeurIDA

title: Optimal Perturbation Budget Allocation for Data Poisoning in Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline Reinforcement Learning (RL) enables policy optimization from static datasets but is inherently vulnerable to data poisoning attacks. Existing attack strategies typically rely on locally uniform perturbations, which treat all samples indiscriminately. This approach is inefficient, as it wastes the perturbation budget on low-impact samples, and lacks stealthiness due to significant statistical deviations. In this paper, we propose a novel Global Budget Allocation attack strategy. Leveraging the theoretical insight that a sample's influence on value function convergence is proportional to its Temporal Difference (TD) error, we formulate the attack as a global resource allocation problem. We derive a closed-form solution where perturbation magnitudes are assigned proportional to the TD-error sensitivity under a global L2 constraint. Empirical results on D4RL benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms baseline strategies, achieving up to 80% performance degradation with minimal perturbations that evade detection by state-of-the-art statistical and spectral defenses.

title: Temporal Concept Dynamics in Diffusion Models via Prompt-Conditioned Interventions
summary: Diffusion models are usually evaluated by their final outputs, gradually denoising random noise into meaningful images. Yet, generation unfolds along a trajectory, and analyzing this dynamic process is crucial for understanding how controllable, reliable, and predictable these models are in terms of their success/failure modes. In this work, we ask the question: when does noise turn into a specific concept (e.g., age) and lock in the denoising trajectory? We propose PCI (Prompt-Conditioned Intervention) to study this question. PCI is a training-free and model-agnostic framework for analyzing concept dynamics through diffusion time. The central idea is the analysis of Concept Insertion Success (CIS), defined as the probability that a concept inserted at a given timestep is preserved and reflected in the final image, offering a way to characterize the temporal dynamics of concept formation. Applied to several state-of-the-art text-to-image diffusion models and a broad taxonomy of concepts, PCI reveals diverse temporal behaviors across diffusion models, in which certain phases of the trajectory are more favorable to specific concepts even within the same concept type. These findings also provide actionable insights for text-driven image editing, highlighting when interventions are most effective without requiring access to model internals or training, and yielding quantitatively stronger edits that achieve a balance of semantic accuracy and content preservation than strong baselines. Code is available at: https://github.com/adagorgun/PCI-Prompt-Controlled-Interventions

title: Autonomous Issue Resolver: Towards Zero-Touch Code Maintenance
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models have revolutionized function-level code generation; however, repository-scale Automated Program Repair (APR) remains a significant challenge. Current approaches typically employ a control-centric paradigm, forcing agents to navigate complex directory structures and irrelevant control logic. In this paper, we propose a paradigm shift from the standard Code Property Graphs (CPGs) to the concept of Data Transformation Graph (DTG) that inverts the topology by modeling data states as nodes and functions as edges, enabling agents to trace logic defects through data lineage rather than control flow. We introduce a multi-agent framework that reconciles data integrity navigation with control flow logic. Our theoretical analysis and case studies demonstrate that this approach resolves the "Semantic Trap" inherent in standard RAG systems in modern coding agents. We provide a comprehensive implementation in the form of Autonomous Issue Resolver (AIR), a self-improvement system for zero-touch code maintenance that utilizes neuro-symbolic reasoning and uses the DTG structure for scalable logic repair. Our approach has demonstrated good results on several SWE benchmarks, reaching a resolution rate of 87.1% on SWE-Verified benchmark. Our approach directly addresses the core limitations of current AI code-assistant tools and tackles the critical need for a more robust foundation for our increasingly software-dependent world.

title: LLM-based Vulnerable Code Augmentation: Generate or Refactor?
comments: 6 pages, Submitted to ESAAN 2026, Under pier review
summary: Vulnerability code-bases often suffer from severe imbalance, limiting the effectiveness of Deep Learning-based vulnerability classifiers. Data Augmentation could help solve this by mitigating the scarcity of under-represented CWEs. In this context, we investigate LLM-based augmentation for vulnerable functions, comparing controlled generation of new vulnerable samples with semantics-preserving refactoring of existing ones. Using Qwen2.5-Coder to produce augmented data and CodeBERT as a vulnerability classifier on the SVEN dataset, we find that our approaches are indeed effective in enriching vulnerable code-bases through a simple process and with reasonable quality, and that a hybrid strategy best boosts vulnerability classifiers' performance.
comment: 6 pages, Submitted to ESAAN 2026, Under pier review

title: On-the-fly Large-scale 3D Reconstruction from Multi-Camera Rigs
summary: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have enabled efficient free-viewpoint rendering and photorealistic scene reconstruction. While on-the-fly extensions of 3DGS have shown promise for real-time reconstruction from monocular RGB streams, they often fail to achieve complete 3D coverage due to the limited field of view (FOV). Employing a multi-camera rig fundamentally addresses this limitation. In this paper, we present the first on-the-fly 3D reconstruction framework for multi-camera rigs. Our method incrementally fuses dense RGB streams from multiple overlapping cameras into a unified Gaussian representation, achieving drift-free trajectory estimation and efficient online reconstruction. We propose a hierarchical camera initialization scheme that enables coarse inter-camera alignment without calibration, followed by a lightweight multi-camera bundle adjustment that stabilizes trajectories while maintaining real-time performance. Furthermore, we introduce a redundancy-free Gaussian sampling strategy and a frequency-aware optimization scheduler to reduce the number of Gaussian primitives and the required optimization iterations, thereby maintaining both efficiency and reconstruction fidelity. Our method reconstructs hundreds of meters of 3D scenes within just 2 minutes using only raw multi-camera video streams, demonstrating unprecedented speed, robustness, and Fidelity for on-the-fly 3D scene reconstruction.

title: Developing Distance-Aware Uncertainty Quantification Methods in Physics-Guided Neural Networks for Reliable Bearing Health Prediction
comments: Under review at Structural health Monitoring - SAGE
summary: Accurate and uncertainty-aware degradation estimation is essential for predictive maintenance in safety-critical systems like rotating machinery with rolling-element bearings. Many existing uncertainty methods lack confidence calibration, are costly to run, are not distance-aware, and fail to generalize under out-of-distribution data. We introduce two distance-aware uncertainty methods for deterministic physics-guided neural networks: PG-SNGP, based on Spectral Normalization Gaussian Process, and PG-SNER, based on Deep Evidential Regression. We apply spectral normalization to the hidden layers so the network preserves distances from input to latent space. PG-SNGP replaces the final dense layer with a Gaussian Process layer for distance-sensitive uncertainty, while PG-SNER outputs Normal Inverse Gamma parameters to model uncertainty in a coherent probabilistic form. We assess performance using standard accuracy metrics and a new distance-aware metric based on the Pearson Correlation Coefficient, which measures how well predicted uncertainty tracks the distance between test and training samples. We also design a dynamic weighting scheme in the loss to balance data fidelity and physical consistency. We test our methods on rolling-element bearing degradation using the PRONOSTIA dataset and compare them with Monte Carlo and Deep Ensemble PGNNs. Results show that PG-SNGP and PG-SNER improve prediction accuracy, generalize reliably under OOD conditions, and remain robust to adversarial attacks and noise.
comment: Under review at Structural health Monitoring - SAGE

title: Learning to Control Physically-simulated 3D Characters via Generating and Mimicking 2D Motions
summary: Video data is more cost-effective than motion capture data for learning 3D character motion controllers, yet synthesizing realistic and diverse behaviors directly from videos remains challenging. Previous approaches typically rely on off-the-shelf motion reconstruction techniques to obtain 3D trajectories for physics-based imitation. These reconstruction methods struggle with generalizability, as they either require 3D training data (potentially scarce) or fail to produce physically plausible poses, hindering their application to challenging scenarios like human-object interaction (HOI) or non-human characters. We tackle this challenge by introducing Mimic2DM, a novel motion imitation framework that learns the control policy directly and solely from widely available 2D keypoint trajectories extracted from videos. By minimizing the reprojection error, we train a general single-view 2D motion tracking policy capable of following arbitrary 2D reference motions in physics simulation, using only 2D motion data. The policy, when trained on diverse 2D motions captured from different or slightly different viewpoints, can further acquire 3D motion tracking capabilities by aggregating multiple views. Moreover, we develop a transformer-based autoregressive 2D motion generator and integrate it into a hierarchical control framework, where the generator produces high-quality 2D reference trajectories to guide the tracking policy. We show that the proposed approach is versatile and can effectively learn to synthesize physically plausible and diverse motions across a range of domains, including dancing, soccer dribbling, and animal movements, without any reliance on explicit 3D motion data. Project Website: https://jiann-li.github.io/mimic2dm/

title: Disrupting Hierarchical Reasoning: Adversarial Protection for Geographic Privacy in Multimodal Reasoning Models
summary: Multi-modal large reasoning models (MLRMs) pose significant privacy risks by inferring precise geographic locations from personal images through hierarchical chain-of-thought reasoning. Existing privacy protection techniques, primarily designed for perception-based models, prove ineffective against MLRMs' sophisticated multi-step reasoning processes that analyze environmental cues. We introduce \textbf{ReasonBreak}, a novel adversarial framework specifically designed to disrupt hierarchical reasoning in MLRMs through concept-aware perturbations. Our approach is founded on the key insight that effective disruption of geographic reasoning requires perturbations aligned with conceptual hierarchies rather than uniform noise. ReasonBreak strategically targets critical conceptual dependencies within reasoning chains, generating perturbations that invalidate specific inference steps and cascade through subsequent reasoning stages. To facilitate this approach, we contribute \textbf{GeoPrivacy-6K}, a comprehensive dataset comprising 6,341 ultra-high-resolution images ($\geq$2K) with hierarchical concept annotations. Extensive evaluation across seven state-of-the-art MLRMs (including GPT-o3, GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro) demonstrates ReasonBreak's superior effectiveness, achieving a 14.4\% improvement in tract-level protection (33.8\% vs 19.4\%) and nearly doubling block-level protection (33.5\% vs 16.8\%). This work establishes a new paradigm for privacy protection against reasoning-based threats.

title: Beyond the Noise: Aligning Prompts with Latent Representations in Diffusion Models
summary: Conditional diffusion models rely on language-to-image alignment methods to steer the generation towards semantically accurate outputs. Despite the success of this architecture, misalignment and hallucinations remain common issues and require automatic misalignment detection tools to improve quality, for example by applying them in a Best-of-N (BoN) post-generation setting. Unfortunately, measuring the alignment after the generation is an expensive step since we need to wait for the overall generation to finish to determine prompt adherence. In contrast, this work hypothesizes that text/image misalignments can be detected early in the denoising process, enabling real-time alignment assessment without waiting for the complete generation. In particular, we propose NoisyCLIP a method that measures semantic alignment in the noisy latent space. This work is the first to explore and benchmark prompt-to-latent misalignment detection during image generation using dual encoders in the reverse diffusion process. We evaluate NoisyCLIP qualitatively and quantitatively and find it reduces computational cost by 50% while achieving 98% of CLIP alignment performance in BoN settings. This approach enables real-time alignment assessment during generation, reducing costs without sacrificing semantic fidelity.

title: OCCDiff: Occupancy Diffusion Model for High-Fidelity 3D Building Reconstruction from Noisy Point Clouds
summary: A major challenge in reconstructing buildings from LiDAR point clouds lies in accurately capturing building surfaces under varying point densities and noise interference. To flexibly gather high-quality 3D profiles of the building in diverse resolution, we propose OCCDiff applying latent diffusion in the occupancy function space. Our OCCDiff combines a latent diffusion process with a function autoencoder architecture to generate continuous occupancy functions evaluable at arbitrary locations. Moreover, a point encoder is proposed to provide condition features to diffusion learning, constraint the final occupancy prediction for occupancy decoder, and insert multi-modal features for latent generation to latent encoder. To further enhance the model performance, a multi-task training strategy is employed, ensuring that the point encoder learns diverse and robust feature representations. Empirical results show that our method generates physically consistent samples with high fidelity to the target distribution and exhibits robustness to noisy data.

title: Thinking with Images via Self-Calling Agent
comments: Code would be released at https://github.com/YWenxi/think-with-images-through-self-calling soon
summary: Thinking-with-images paradigms have showcased remarkable visual reasoning capability by integrating visual information as dynamic elements into the Chain-of-Thought (CoT). However, optimizing interleaved multimodal CoT (iMCoT) through reinforcement learning remains challenging, as it relies on scarce high-quality reasoning data. In this study, we propose Self-Calling Chain-of-Thought (sCoT), a novel visual reasoning paradigm that reformulates iMCoT as a language-only CoT with self-calling. Specifically, a main agent decomposes the complex visual reasoning task to atomic subtasks and invokes its virtual replicas, i.e. parameter-sharing subagents, to solve them in isolated context. sCoT enjoys substantial training effectiveness and efficiency, as it requires no explicit interleaving between modalities. sCoT employs group-relative policy optimization to reinforce effective reasoning behavior to enhance optimization. Experiments on HR-Bench 4K show that sCoT improves the overall reasoning performance by up to $1.9\%$ with $\sim 75\%$ fewer GPU hours compared to strong baseline approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/YWenxi/think-with-images-through-self-calling.
